dialogs.content: Hey, {PlayerName}? What brought you here?
You always manage to stumble upon important places.
This is a holy dating spot for couples. It's said that if couples come to this pond and make a wish to the sky while the frogs croak, they can stick by each other as long as they live.
This grassy slope and pond are indeed nothing special. The key, however, lies in the call of the Black-Striped Frogs.
Alwa, alwa, alwa.
Doesn't that sound like "always"? Couples think that means "always and forever", and wish this will bless their love.
They even give the Black-Striped Frogs a nickname, "Alwa Frog".
Well, it's just couples project their own expectations on an animal.
Well, for me, it's more like a faith-shall-work-wonders thing.
Anyway, we're taking this a little too far. Let's install the module first.

dialogs.content: The textbooks are boring enough already, sis. Can’t we make the magazine just a little more interesting?

It’s called “A Look Inside Jinzhou”, to broaden students’ horizons and satisfy their curiosity.
But my sister thought the draft was too narrow in terms of who would be interested in it. If it doesn’t catch on, it won’t serve its purpose of helping people learn.
{PlayerName}, do you mind helping us by taking a small test?
It’s only a simple quiz. It wouldn’t matter if you answer them correctly or not.
I just want to confirm whether the learning points are that uncommon and perplexing or not.
I can’t thank you enough!
I look forward to your performance.
You can just think of it as us having a casual chat. I’m also curious about what you’ve seen and heard in Jinzhou so far.
The test results will be kept confidential, and will only be used as a reference for future writing changes.
So you don’t need to worry too much, {PlayerName}.

dialogs.content: In the land of the Daxia, I am practicing the art of overdashing, hoping to one day become a skilled swordsman.

I learned these words from the novel "The Seven Swords of Qingren" by Kuhai. This book is very popular in my homeland, and if I want to become a new generation of Kung Fu heroes, I must learn from all aspects!
Qingren heroes are the main characters in the novel "The Seven Swords of Qingren" and are mysterious swordsmen of unknown identity, known as Chiqiu.
Hidden in the darkness, swiftly overdashing, landing silently, and striking mercilessly.
This is the greatest characteristic of Qingren heroes. I am also following in their footsteps, starting from the most basic overdashing, and practicing supreme Kung Fu!
Not only that! Overdashing is also the most important competition in the global fan club of Qingren heroes.
Every year, at the beginning of the year, enthusiasts gather together to showcase their skills and compete for the title of Overdashing Master.
This world championship has been going on for many years and has expanded several times. It has become a famous street competition and a fashionable sport in my hometown.
I am not only a participant, but also a leader and promoter in the training field of Jinzhou. I work hard to become the Overdashing Master next year, one step closer to being a Qixia!
Ku Hai will tell the winner a Qixia story that no one else knows! It is a hidden Easter egg that belongs only to one person, and it is our greatest honor and motivation!
If you want to participate in the competition, you can sign up and train with me.

First, as a hero, you rarely taste defeat with your mortal body. As followers, we need to complete the challenges <color=yellow>relying solely on our own abilities, without borrowing any external powers</color>.

Third, as a hero, you can hide in high places, your presence unknown to others. <color=yellow>Swift movements can only be made on the rooftops, challengers must not touch the ground</color> and must not seek other paths.
These are the requirements for the art of overdashing.
Great! You have a unique talent. You must be a martial arts expert. You are our partner!

The Dim Forest was a famous zoo before the Lament, known for its animal performances.
Because of their high intelligence, the apes could master many skills. They were the first to be trained for performances, becoming the most popular exhibits.
After the Lament, humans gradually fled the forest. The apes built their nests, becoming the masters, and even started to attack humans.
At first, humans could handle it, until they were infected by the Tacetite, and mutated into the more dangerous creatures they are now.
So... setting traps, locking humans in tree cages, and making humans perform in the theater... is their clumsy revenge, at least that's what I think.
Using the knowledge taught by humans, they are returning what humans have done to them in double.
That's probably it, do you have any other questions?
It's probably a... amusement place? Before the Lament, humans liked to lock animals in cages, rooms, in other words, in fixed areas, for visitors to appreciate.
The largest venue, it is said, can exhibit five to six hundred animals at the same time, and it has also spawned a huge supporting industry.
How much idle time did the people before the Lament have to squander... it's unimaginable now.
Hmm, should it be considered lucky, or unlucky...
It was originally a special albino individual, rescued by humans from the wild and kept in a zoo, and it was deeply loved by visitors because of its eye-catching appearance.
Gradually, it became the star of the zoo, and every time it performed, the venue was packed.
But because of this, the albino orangutan was forced to undergo stricter training, learning to do things that only humans can do...
There were also some people, from the orangutan's perspective, who opposed animal performances.
But their voices were too small, and in the end, they were unable to stop the Feilian Beringal from taking the path of revenge... this is a futile effort, don't you think?
Oh, it's strange, the big leader mobilized a large number of troops in the Dim Forest, but in the end, nothing happened.
It is said that the message conveyed by the Feilian Beringal before its death affected the entire monkey group.
Contrary to expectations, the aggression and combat power of the monkeys have greatly decreased, and it is much easier to deal with.
The Midnight Rangers will also arrange a permanent training ground in the Dim Forest, and you can go and have a look if you have nothing to do.
Although I rarely praise people, I have to say that you did a good job with the Feilian Beringal.
Oh, there's also a video of it when it was a baby.
In fact, albino individuals have a hard time surviving in the wild, so objectively speaking, it was humans who gave it a life.
The people who saved it were probably researchers or something, it's quite romantic, they even held a celebration ceremony when it completed its treatment and left the rescue cabin.
I saw it was quite happy, jumping around on the backs of those people, haha.
I wonder if it started to know about "humans" from that time on?
Alright, that's enough talking. Take care, I won't see you off.

dialogs.content: Can we trust him?
If only I could... It's all my fault...
Can we trust him?
If only I could... It's all my fault...
*sigh* Ruiyun...
*sigh* Ruiyun...
*sigh* Why won't you listen, Ruiyun...
*sigh* Why won't you listen, Ruiyun...
I'm begging you. Miss Koko, you must have some way to save my daughter.
But...
Is it about the payment? I'll give you all my savings if that's what it takes.
It's not about the money!
{PlayerName}, you're here. But sorry, the shop's closed for now.
Don't worry. I'm okay. This lady here isn't a threat.
Her daughter's dealing with a rare illness—non-life-threatening for now, but it could get worse.
Doctors have tried everything, but regular medicine isn't working. There's one last hope, though.
Yes, my teacher handled a similar case before, and I still have the prescription from back then.
The issue is, the crucial "guide drug" is tough to get.
The "guide drug" is the most critical ingredient in the prescription. Currently, only some wealthy folks have the "guide drug" we need, and they probably won't sell it for money unless...
Unless you can find some rare items to exchange with them. Oh, by the way, Rover, have you ever heard of something called "Bell Spiriton"?
If we had that "Bell Spiriton," we could use it to exchange for the "guide drug."
It's not something easy to obtain.
Miss Koko, do you know how to get it? I'll do anything!
You can only find "Bell Spiriton" from a Calamity-Class Tacet Discord called Bell-Borne Geochelone. Have you heard of it?
Even Rover hasn't heard of it. Not that surprising, though. Only a handful of people have the chance to see it.
It's said to have a body as huge as a mountain, can crush an armored car with only one step, and freeze a river with a single breath!
Many tried to hunt it down in the past, but they all became revenants frozen in the river.
However, it doesn't usually leave its territory, so it's even rarer for people to see it.
People with sanity won't willingly pick fights with it, let alone risk their lives for an herb.
Yeah, you get how formidable it is. Nobody dares to challenge it, not to mention putting their lives on the line for an herb.
Seriously? You took it down? You're not pulling my leg, right?
Even so, you didn't get the "Bell Spiriton." That's a pity.
How can this be? Is there really no way?
Hmm…
Well, there's someone I know who might still have some "Bell Spiritons," but the problem is, he's a bit unreliable.
Not sure, but he did sell me plenty of rare TD materials before. It seems like he's got a few tricks up his sleeve.
Please tell me how I can find him. No matter how slim the hope is, I'll give it a try.
Thanks! So, let this lady stick around to help me prepare other herbs, and I'll leave the task of obtaining "Bell Spiriton" to {PlayerName}? Sound good?
His name's Lianfeng, and he hangs around the theater all the time. You should spot him there.
He goes by "TD Hunter" and talks a big game about hunting formidable TDs, although no one has actually seen him fight.
If you see someone being loud and boastful over tea at the theater, that's Lianfeng.

Rover, please help me. I've got no other options.
Hey, Lianfeng, you have a guest here.
Who are you? I don't know you.
Are you looking for me? Who told you I'm here?
Darn. Did she send you to collect debts?
Nothing, forget it. Anyway, why are you looking for me? Spill it. I don't have time to waste.
Come on! You're just having tea here with us. Oh! Nice tea.
Just so you know, if you're here to borrow money, then you can turn around and leave. I'm broke. Flat broke.
You can sell those PRECIOUS materials you've obtained from TDs, huh? They should earn you a great sum.
I sold them all a long time ago.
I don't have any. Speaking of which, I once obtained some from a TD called Bell-Borne Geochelone. Well, forget about it. After all, you won't have a chance to see it.
Why am I telling you all this? You're just wasting my time. Get outta here; don't spoil my moment drinking this delicious tea.
I'm not lying, but I'm the only one that can obtain "Bell Spiriton".
Then why not go take down that Bell-Borne thing again?
Seriously? I'm not going! I'm tired of dealing with minions like Bell-Borne Geochelone. Whoever wants to go can go by themselves.
If you're that strong, why did you quit the Pioneer Association? Or, were you kicked out?
I heard from Miss Maqi that you quit. So it's true, huh?
Nonsense. I quit because I don't need any companions or assistance to take down TDs.
I'm a lone wolf. I don't waste time getting along with people.
Hey, friend, I remember you're Rover who just came to Jinzhou, right? Why do you want this thing?
That's unfortunate, but so what? Why should I help someone I barely know? Go find someone else.
Hey, how can you be so cruel? Have some compassion!
Oh my, I really can't stand stories like this.
What's the matter with you two?
Ugh, but…
Hahaha! Please explain this matter in detail to us Pioneer Association!
Sorry for the abrupt intrusion! We didn't intend to eavesdrop your conversation. It's just your voices were a bit loud.
Tsk, are all members of the Pioneer Association this rude?
In fact, we're the Explorers of the Pioneer Association, and I'm the captain of this squad. Are you Rover? Nice to meet you!
Haha, Lianfeng, you're ignored!
Shut up. Hey, what do you want?
Well, we're heading to the Gorges of Spirits to investigate a giant Tacet Discord found there.
Yes. Our goal is to take Bell-Borne Geochelone down for further research.
Then we happened to hear your conversation and thought if we could help the unfortunate mother and daughter at the same time, it'd be great.
That's great! Please help them!
You're such good guys, unlike Lianfeng.
Are you insane?
Don't worry. We've thoroughly investigated Bell-Borne Geochelone, and our squad is composed of experienced Resonators.
But we've never heard of this "Bell Spiriton" before. It seems like an interesting research subject. I'm sure the Editorial Department will be thrilled.
Well, Rover, just wait for our good news! Bye!
Wait, that's too dangerous! You're all going to die! Hey, stop!
Just let them do their work, Lianfeng. You're being ridiculous.
Me? Ridiculous? I just don't want to see them throw away their lives so rashly!
I'm not a member of the Pioneer Association anymore. They can do whatever they want. I don't care.
But they're underestimating that TD. Members of the Pioneer Association are too focused on research and investigation. Sometimes, they forget they're dealing with extremely formidable creatures.
Since you're a man of strength, why not join in and help out? We'll respect you as a true man.
Tsk, easy for you to say.
Look, he's backing down.
Are you underestimating me? Fine, I'll go! But I won't help them fight Bell-Borne Geochelone. I already said I'm done with the Pioneer Association!
I'll tell {Male=him;Female=her} how to take down Bell-Borne Geochelone as {Male=his;Female=her} "Master"!
Looks like you're skilled enough. With my guidance, you'll be more capable than those guys in the future.
Well, as long as you're happy.
Good. Hope you'll be as composed facing that formidable TD.
Tsk. Anyway, with an experienced "TD hunter" by your side, nothing could go wrong.
One more time!
In that case, you'll know I wasn't bragging. Wait and see.
Rover, come! Let's have a private talk over there. Don't let these fools hear.
As if we'd love to hear. We've had our fill of tea. Bye.
Boss, put it on Lianfeng's tab!
Out, out, out! Get out! Don't waste our time.

Aren't you afraid to fight against TDs?
I mean, Bell-Borne Geochelone is a very dangerous opponent. You might get hurt or even lose your life fighting it.
Though that mother and daughter are quite pitiful, you don't have an obligation to help them.
Even if you back out now, no one can blame you, including that mother and daughter.
Keep this conversation between us. I'll try to figure out a way to get the "Bell Spiriton" for you, so you don't have to risk your life.
Though we've only known each other for a short time, I don't want to see you die on my watch.
You've got some guts. Well, not bad.
Hmph. Are you doubting that I've never hunted that TD?
That's straightforward.
Fine, even though you said that, I can tell from your expression that you're not fully convinced.
Can't blame you. Honestly, I sometimes doubt if I'm a true "TD Hunter" myself.
Have you heard of the Overclocking of a Resonator?
You're quite knowledgeable. Have you ever encountered a Resonator after Overclocking?

Seriously? You've never heard of it? Given the fact you're a Resonator, that's a surprise. Overclocking is a negative phenomenon that occurs in Resonators. Different Resonators have different symptoms.
If left unchecked, it can lead to severe aftereffects, even completely altering a Resonator's personality.
For example, I'm one of the unlucky Resonators who went through it.
You've experienced Overclocking before?
Perhaps, I don't really remember because the researchers at the Academy confirmed that I lost most of my memories after Overclocking.
Some memories, like how to fight those TDs, stay with me—no matter how hard I've tried to forget them.
Though in those memories, I always hunted them alone. There's always this strange feeling of unnaturalness... Forget it. You won't understand.
Anyway, not the right time to talk about this now.
Let's go. I'll head to the meeting point outside Jinzhou and wait for you there. I already sent the coordinates to your Terminal.
If you're ready, meet me there. Don't dawdle. We need to catch up with them!

I'm fine. Just a bit careless to be attacked by those minions. Not a big deal. I scared them off effortlessly.
What's with that look! Seems like it's time for your first lesson as my apprentice.
Rule Number One for "TD Hunter"—"Never look down upon minions!"
Even weaker enemies can cause unexpected trouble. Got it?
Ahem, I intentionally put myself in danger to teach you a lesson.
Alright, it's your loss not listening to me. I'm speaking from experience.
Good, remember my words. They'll be useful to you one day.
Bell-Borne Geochelone lives in the Gorges of Spirits, which is the source of the Qing River flowing through here. I can sense the state of a TD through the remaining frequency in the medium.

I told you that only I can find the "Bell Spiriton," right? It's because Bell-Borne Geochelone emits a special frequency during specific periods, and only when defeating it during these periods can one get the "Bell Spiriton."
No matter how many times you defeat Bell-Borne Geochelone, as long as it's not the right timing, you can't get the "Bell Spiriton," and only my Resonance Ability can tell if it's the right timing.
We're pretty lucky. There's a high chance we'll get the "Bell Spiriton" if we hunt Bell-Borne Geochelone now.
Plus, it seems that those from the Pioneer Association are planning to go to the Gorges of Spirits along the river.
Seems like they're well-prepared. The Pioneer Association is really interested in Bell-Borne Geochelone.
You wanna know? Curiosity is a good trait! The more you know about your enemy before a battle, the more confident you'll be.

Let's start from the question "how Tacet Discords are formed." Most people believe that they are born out of chaos, but there are some exceptions—some TDs seem to come from legends or even real history.
Legend has it that the ancient army in Huanglong used to sound a bronze bell in battle, inspiring soldiers to fight bravely and symbolizing the good wish of a triumphant return.
One day, the bell ringer saved a turtle along the Qing River by accident. From then on, that turtle became an indispensable part of the soldiers, sharing their happiness and sorrow.
Before the fierce battle ended, the bell ringer died. However, the sound of the bell still echoed on the battlefield. It's said that the turtle was the one who sounded the bell.
Yes, that's the story. Later, someone found a rusted ancient bell in the Gorges of Spirits, similar in style to the bronze bell the ancient army used.

Underneath that ancient bell was a giant turtle-shaped Tacet Discord. It witnessed the fierce war and bid farewell to the bell ringer and soldiers. These memories tied the heavy ancient bell to its back.
But it's just a story. After all, no one knows if TDs have memories and emotions.
No matter what happened in the past, this TD is now a hideous creature bringing nothing other than pain and torture to Huanglong.
You don't need to show any mercy. If it really had emotions, it wouldn't want to be a creature destroying happiness and peace of people in Huanglong.
Rule Number Two for "TD Hunter"—"Never show mercy to Tacet Discords!"
The Pioneer Association should have left not long ago. Let's follow their traces and catch up quickly!
Have you used the Scan function on the Terminal?
Wonderful. Let's follow the path displayed on the Terminal and track them down.
This is where having me as your master comes in handy. I can teach you everything you wanna know.
Turn on your Terminal and select the Scan function. You'll see a path displayed on the screen, and all you need to do is to follow it!
Understand? Great, let's follow the path displayed on the Terminal and track them down.

These are the TDs that just attacked me.
Be careful. They seem to get extremely aggressive due to the awakening of Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Even someone as experienced as me got caught up in a tough battle.

That sound…
It's a signal that Bell-Borne Geochelone is waking up.
Ugh… My head…
Nothing, just a bit of a headache.
(Darn, it's happening again. It feels like something in my memories is about to be awakened.)
The problem is, the traces left by the Pioneer Association members seem to disappear here…
Right, they must be where the bell sound is. Let's go.

Hey! Wake up! Can you hear me!
Ugh, you are… those people at the teahouse?
Enough talking. I'll check your injuries with my Forte.
No major organ damage, but there are multiple fractures. Did you fight against Bell-Borne Geochelone?
Ha, it can't be called a fight. We're completely crushed.
You should leave. Though it's calm now, no one knows when it'll wake up again.
It's not an opponent you ordinary people can deal with.
Ordinary people? You've got us wrong. I'm Lianfeng, a professional "TD Hunter," and this is my top apprentice.
You guys stay here and rest. Leave the rest to us.
{PlayerName}, listen carefully to what I'm about to say.
Do you see the large bell in the center of the "Bell-Borne Ravine"? Ringing it will awaken Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Since it's giant, it moves and turns slowly, so we'd better…
Staying away from it will only force us into corners with its massive body. It can also use icy breath and condense water into ice crystals for indiscriminate attacks.
Though it may seem crazy, it's actually safer to get as close to it as possible.
Yeah, getting close allows us to take advantage of its blind spots during its turns and attacks. Smart move.
Its four legs, head, and tail are all highly offensive weapons. Don't underestimate them.
Also, its weakness is the big bell on its back, but it's relatively high and not easy to attack under normal circumstances.
You have a clear head, huh?
Bell-Borne Geochelone's feet are covered in hard ice, protecting them from hard.
However, it's also its weakness. Once the ice is shattered, Bell-Borne Geochelone will lose balance and fall down, which gives us a good chance to attack its most vulnerable point.
I'll draw its attention, and you seize the chance to attack.
Tsk, are you underestimating a "TD Hunter"? Once you figure out its attack pattern, dodging is easy. That's how we took it down before.
We... I... Ugh, my head...
(In my memory, there's a group of people fighting alongside me.)
(Who were they?)
Ugh… my head hurts!
It's dangerous to confront Bell-Borne Geochelone on your own.
Wait, {PlayerName}!!

dialogs.content: Hey, aren't you that Rover? You awake?
This is the weather observatory in the Port City of Guixu. You passed out during a battle with the Inferno Rider. Some guys from Lollo Logistics brought you here.
Oh, that's the Tacet Discord you just met. It looks like a rider on a motorbike, so I named it the Inferno Rider. A good name, isn't it?

Our detection shows that the anomalous gravity field here is giving birth to a giant storm, which will sweep the pollen of Incinero Petal to the upper air.

Incinero Petal is not a kind of plant, but an animal Tacet Discord. The flower-like structure is actually the end of its limbs.
To eliminate the Incinero Petals themselves is pointless. To stop the pollen from spreading, we must destroy the Tacet Mark at its core.
Initially, we were thinking about blowing that thing up...
Technically, it didn't "come" to us; it was "discovered". That Inferno Rider seems to have been in the depths of Sea of Flames since that crisis many years ago.
Launching a direct assault on the Tacet Mark core deep within the Sea of Flames was already a daunting task, and with this Tacet Discord in play, our mission now seems nearly impossible.
The special properties of the Sea of Flames make it safer for solo missions, so I've posted the wanted posters, hoping to recruit some skilled Resonators to defeat that TD.
We don't know either. You should ask the guys from Lollo Logistics who brought you back. They're right outside the observatory.

Guess what? I found the Main Core.
Wait, are you serious? Does that mean we can actually solve the issue?

Then we can solve this issue! But...

But...

"This work proved to be a very dangerous one. Should you continue, you risk losing your loved ones, friends... and everything you hold dear till this day."
"Looking back from the end, the data you worked so hard to obtain is but a candle in the wind, always on the verge of being extinguished."

The Rangers who fought till the end.
TDs imitate behaviors to evolve. The more they fight, the faster they evolve.

Oh my... I can’t stand this...

The Huaxu Academy created Explosive Spears to do the job, but the terrain was too dangerous for any regular vehicle to get through.
Most of the Tacetite vehicles were tied up at the frontlines with the Midnight Rangers, fighting off the TD Outbreak, so we couldn't get the Spears to the center of the Sea of Flames.

So this is the true confidence of our Rover!

Or rather, it's nearly impossible for the Magistrate to leave Jinzhou at all.

It is a horological device that tells time by using sunlight's direction.

It seems this sundial is supposed to show both time and direction, but how could it work when there is not a compass attached? Not to mention the lack of sunlight basically renders it useless...
Ugh. That requires way too much brain power...
The color of this leaf seems a bit odd. Can't tell what tree it is.
I think... I can feel something from it...
Hmm... Nevermind. It's too faint. Maybe it was just my imagination...
Sorry. I can't tell what kind of tree this leaf belongs to, either.
This is... A mangosteen fruit.
Mangosteens are not native to Jinzhou. They are usually imported by boat. I think we can find more mangosteens being sold at the nearby markets.

With pleasure. What do you wish to know about Jinzhou?
The Midnight Rangers, under General Jiyan's command, are a garrison in Jinzhou. They consist of the Vanguards for offensive operations against Tacet Discords, and the Rearguards for city defense.
Additionally, there is a detachment unit called the Outriders, mostly made up of volunteers or reservists who serve as reconnaissance agents.
Most of the servicemen of today are comprised of Resonators.
Jinzhou is not the most populated city in Huanglong. As a border city, it is the frontline in countering Tacet Discord Outbreaks.
...Jinzhou holds a special place in my heart.
...I can't say I am too familiar with my hometown, but I do feel a homely sense of attachment to Jinzhou. Maybe it's because here lives a person who changed my life.
Hmm. If I were to introduce Jinzhou in my own words, I'd say it's a city one would easily grow attached to.
Of course. Please feel free to ask me anything, and I will answer to the best of my ability.
Our Magistrate's birth name was Hsi. She took on the name Jinhsi when she became the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
Nowadays, she is usually addressed as "Madam Magistrate."
She is also known as the "Loong Maiden", because of her Resonance connection with our Sentinel, "Jué", who manifests in the shape of a <ano=Dragon>Loong</ano>.
The ways Huanglong's Magistrates interact with their corresponding Sentinels can differ. In Jinzhou, our Magistrate seems to share a familial bond with the Sentinel.

It depends on Madam Magistrate, and...

dialogs.content: Jinzhou is the gateway to Huanglong, and the Desorock Highland is the gateway to Jinzhou. A single breach could have dire consequences. Our defense must hold at all costs.
The Tacet Discords are not humans. They don't do truces or ceasefires. For as long as they exist, this war will rage on endlessly.
Supply is the lifeblood of our army, and I am tasked with keeping it flowing. But now, we are facing a shortage.
I saw you help arrange the wounded there. Xiulan would need your help more than I do.
Thank you, but I must remain to oversee vital military supplies.
Jianxin asked the quartermaster about Zhiyuan's whereabouts.
Zhiyuan...
So he never sent a letter home? Not even once?

The Midnight Rangers are no longer recruiting non-Resonators lately, but Zhiyuan was a stubborn boy. Last year when the battles hadn't gotten so intense, he would trail us Rearguards, eager to join the frontline.
We sent him back to the city, time and time again, and he just kept finding ways to come back. Eventually I caved and took him in to help us here at the base.

With the battle escalating, it's getting increasingly dangerous out here. I shouldn't keep him here any longer. I was just thinking about having the logistics team bring him back to the city when you guys showed up.
Oh, now I remember. He should be currently on the floor above.
Sure. Please excuse me. I'll join you later.
Jianxin did a brief salute and left.
What... what are you doing!
Oh... Please excuse me. Thought that was a grenade... Is this... a mangosteen?

content.content: What do you know about the mangosteen?

dialogs.content: It's a type of old-fashioned explosive. The Lament caused a global technological regression and shortage of resources.
While Tacetite Weapons were being developed, most people had limited knowledge of Tacetite as an energy source. As a result, primitive products combining old and new technology emerged.
The hand grenade was one of them. With the rapid growth of Tacetite Weapons, these crude explosives were eventually phased out in favor of more advanced weaponry.

Well... it's not a local fruit, so we can only get it through imports. But, with the recent Tacet Discord outbreaks, we've had to prioritize bringing in the essentials. We'll get back to importing more of these after General Jiyan makes his triumphant return.
Currently, there's only one waterway open, from Port Gunchao in the <color=Highlight>south</color> of the city. The Rearguards would regularly go there to escort goods.
Hmm... What more do I know... The military rarely buys this fruit for rations due to its short shelf life. Plus, it looks too much like a grenade, and that could cause some issues.
Have you confirmed the inventory? What about the spare list? Sort out the consumables as soon as possible. Check our communication lines while you're at it...
Yue, deliver this list to Ase. Oh, you're not Yue. Where is she? What do you need?
Excuse me. I'm an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers. This is Rover, and this is Master Jianxin who came here to look for someone.

dialogs.content: Are you also Midnight Rangers? Can you tell me about the battles on the front line?
Really? I knew it! What about the other soldiers? Have they all come back?
Why do I only see a few of you?
Are you kidding me? How is it possible that there is no movement at all? Aren't you Midnight Rangers?
...Ah? What, what did I do! I just secretly sneaked into the army, that's all?
Scary, are you guys hired by my grandpa to bring me back home!?
It's not because there is no other way. After I arrived in Jinzhou, I inquired around and heard that the front line was in a fierce battle. I thought it was a good opportunity for me to contribute...

I have always heard that everyone in Jinzhou is a soldier, and I thought that as long as I was a volunteer, I could go to the front line and contribute. Who knew that the organization of the Midnight Rangers has changed...

Since you're already here, you shouldn't just come for nothing, right? This is where my grandfather served when he was young. It would be nice to take a look, even if just for a moment! As for joining the army, let's think of a way. There are always more solutions than difficulties!
Thank you, I will continue to work hard!
Rover, now is not the time to encourage him!
Of course not... not entirely... I made up my mind to reach Jinzhou, but I didn't expect the journey to be so difficult...
Look, this monument was erected by my grandfather here back then. I never thought I would be able to see it after so many years. It's like a dream come true...
Is it true? No, please don't! My grandfather's glorious achievements will be tarnished because of me!
Rover, don't scare him...
Zhiyuan, just like you, your grandfather came to Jinzhou alone from your hometown to find your whereabouts.
What?! My grandfather is in Jinzhou now? Is he okay? Is he injured? Does my family know?
This old man, he can't take care of himself no matter what. My mom must be so worried!
Don't worry, Grandpa Zhiyuan is safe. I came down from the mountain and accompanied him all the way to Jinzhou.

dialogs.content: Rover, I'm afraid I won't be able to escort Zhiyuan back to the city.
I want to stay.
Yes.
This is part of the reason.
Actually, up to now, we have found Zhiyuan and seen that he is safe and sound, which is a good result that Mister Zongye has been concerned about.
On this journey, I have seen a world different from before.

The unity of the people of Jinzhou, the remembrance and longing on the square, the reliability of the Tian Gong defense, the strictness and responsibility of the officers, the destitution and wrong path of the wanderers...
And the busyness here, and the beliefs and courage of the people that Zhiyuan has shown me, whether in the past or now...
I haven't seen what the battlefield is like, but I seem to have some understanding of war.
At this moment, the front not far away should be much more difficult and intense than what we have seen along the way.
Countless lives have been lost in this war...
Master Rongfu once told me, "The best sages gain enlightenment in the military, the mediocre sages gain enlightenment in the bustling cities, and the worst sages gain enlightenment in seclusion."
I used to practice in the city, helping the poor, helping the weak, and punishing the evil, all with my own strength, helping with the small things I saw in life.
This journey has made me start to understand the meaning of the first sentence in Master's words.
So, I want to stay. This is what I want to do for Jinzhou now, and it is also an opportunity for me to continue to pursue and gain insight.
You don't have to worry about me anymore, I have made up my mind!
I have decided to return to Jinzhou City and contribute to the war there!
Hehe, actually, the words of Master Jianxin inspired me. The things she used to help others with, I think I can do them too.
It's true! These are all my heartfelt words!
The words of Master Jianxin inspired me. The things she used to help others with, I think I can do them too.
And coming here, I have also seen the true face of the front line.
I can't compare to the Resonators, and continuing to stay here might indeed be a burden, but after returning to the city, there are many things I can do!
So why shouldn't I go back to a place that suits me better? That way, I might be able to help more people, just like Master Jianxin, and also gain more recognition.
That goes without saying, don't underestimate me.
As for you, don't worry about me anymore. I feel bad enough for making you go through all this trouble.

dialogs.content: This monument was erected many years ago for a legion that sacrificed themselves on this land.

Over thirty years ago, this was a battlefield filled with gunpowder. It was not until that legion pushed back the Tacet Discord and gradually reclaimed the front line that they had the opportunity to erect this monument here.
The names of all of them are engraved on this stone monument.
Although I don't know any of them, my grandpa talked about them so much that my ears have calluses!
When I was little, he rarely mentioned his experiences in the war. It's only in recent years that he has become less clear-headed and started to repeatedly tell me stories of his youth.
Grandpa might be afraid of forgetting these things, so he always wants to tell them to remind himself!
Anyway, I've heard it countless times, I can't forget it even if I want to. Even if Grandpa forgets, I can remember it for decades.
Although I can't see clearly the names carved on the monument, I can recite them backwards.
Look, this is Shen Yin, his nickname is Divine Eagle because he is exceptionally good at marksmanship.

He held his gun at the front line for two days to ensure the safe retreat of others. When he went back to save him, he found that his leg had already been broken, he had lost too much blood, and he maintained the posture of shooting before he died.
This is... Xiao Douzi, she doesn't have a name, everyone calls her that.
When the Tacet Discord suddenly erupted, she was the first to rush out and sound the alarm, attracting the attention of the Tacet Discord and sacrificing herself to buy time for others to react.
Do you want to hear more?
This is Yuan Dong... and this one next to him is Bei Mo...

Yuan Dong was originally a military doctor. When the Tacet Discord erupted that night, it was too sudden and there was no room for any medical support. He died in the confrontation with the Tacet Discord.

Bei Mo was found in the collapsed area after the battle. The war lasted for seven days, and he saved more than a dozen soldiers in the sealed underground, only to find that they had died of starvation.
This is Zi Yu, and this is Xiao Hua...
Do you want to hear more?
Hmm, then I'll sit here for a while.

dialogs.content: Say, you youngling over there. When will the war be over?
Yes... Wars never end.
And our brave soldiers will remain with us always.
Is that so...
Should the day arrive when I am no longer here, I implore you, my child, to take my place as a witness.
Last night, I had a dream about a peaceful future with no wars.
But when I woke up, I realized I had dreamt about the past.
I'm getting up there in years. I've been on battlefields for most of my life.
Now, I'm just a flickering candle in the wind, surviving on nostalgia. Don't worry about an old-timer like me.
I'll stick around a bit more, then it's my turn to kick the bucket.

dialogs.content: I have the equipment ready. I'll need to check your health status and see if there are any unusual fluctuations.

Based on the samples collected, the Tacet Discord you defeated was at least an Overlord Class. After defeating it, you seemingly absorbed its frequency energy with your bare hands.

Tacet Discords are classified according to the concentration levels of their characteristic frequencies. Generally, Tacet Discords with higher concentration levels are considered to pose greater threats.
The current classification levels, from lowest to highest, are Common, Elite, Overlord, and Calamity. Additionally, there is a special type of Tacet Discord, and we call them the Threnodians.
You have absorbed a very powerful Echo with your body. You may seem fine now, but there could be internal changes that are too subtle to see or detect with my Resonance Ability.
Based on all the records I can find, humans need a Pangu Terminal in order to record or replicate an Echo's frequency.
That's why I am quite curious how you could do that.
When a Tacet Discord is eliminated, its frequency energy may linger in the form of an incorporeal manifestation, which is known as a "Reverberation".
A Resonator's Terminal collects and records said Reverberations, turning them into "Echoes" that can be directed as desired.
The combat abilities of these Echoes can then be replicated through the Terminal's Data Bank module, enabling Resonators to use them in battles.
Additionally, some Echoes' abilities allow Resonators to briefly transform into their shapes.
Yes, to some extent.
Apart from the ancient legend Yangyang mentioned earlier, I've never heard of anything like this...
But if we look at it another way, we might finally be able to verify said legend once we figure out what really happened with your body.

The Crownless' frequency energy was "consumed" by your body, leaving no trace behind.
But how did you manage to do that? It's as though there's another mechanism within your body capable of absorbing frequency energy...
How do you define "monster"? For Resonators like you, such abnormal fluctuations in frequency typically lead to Overclocking.
When a Resonator's mental capacity is overwhelmed, they may lose control of their <ano=power>Forte</ano>, causing an overflow of Resonance energy.
This is known as "Overclocking" and is categorized into three levels based on severity. The excess Resonance energy harms both the Resonator and their surroundings.

We have established a comprehensive Overclock diagnosis process to accurately predict potential risks of Overclocking.
Your waveform graph shows a remarkable level of stability, surpassing any Resonator I've encountered. Your risk of Overclocking should be minimal.
You don't need to worry about that for the time being.
I can't say without sufficient data.
Your test results don't indicate any trauma, so your amnesia may not be linked to traumatic events.
As for your ability to absorb Echoes, I can't make a connection between that and your amnesia based on the current data.
To put it simply, it seems there is another dimension or... a creature, hiding inside your body.
I used that as a metaphor to express my speculation. If such a thing existed within you, scientists would be eagerly seeking to understand it.
There are so many mysteries about you worth exploring.
A universe. That's a poetic and intriguing comparison.
It seems we need a simulated combat to figure out what happened in your body.
Please hold your Terminal tight and stay still.

dialogs.content: Mr. Mortefi, we found the parts.
Good. Bring it to me.
The test results are in.
The mangosteen is just an ordinary fruit. It's suitable for regular consumption. We found nothing unusual about it.
From the purple leaf you presented, I detected subtle fluctuations in Tacet Discord's frequency from two distinct sources, but they were overlapping and difficult to distinguish.
This is a rare occurrence.
The scattered nature of these fluctuations rules out the possibility of them being left behind through contact.
This is not an ordinary leaf, but it doesn't seem to be a Tacet Discord, either. Based on the data we gathered, I believe it was sampled from an area struck with the Waveworn phenomena.
Yes. The anomalies that occurred after the Lament, including the formation of Tacet Fields, Etheric Sea, Retroact Rain, and gravity loss... These are collectively called the Waveworn phenomena.
And the Lament was the start of it all.
As for the sugar pearl... It has been determined to be a type of oral vaccine.
This sugar pearl expired over 20 years ago. The low-temperature storage life for this vaccine is about 2 years.
A 20-year-old vaccine...
Could it be related to the children's epidemic in Jinzhou two decades ago?
The archives in the Academy should have information on the sugar pearl.
The archives here are organized in a unique way. You can start by searching the keywords at the lobby terminal.
Mr. Mortefi?
The missing pointer has been installed, and now the sundial should be complete.
So the discs are rotatable now...
Yes. Align the correct markers with the pointer we just installed, and then you should be able to open it.
You... Ugh, hold on!
Remember when I said don't force it open?
Crank that thing another five degrees, and not even Xiangli Yao will be able to save it.
The Earthly Branches and Four Symbols...

Now what kind of information could it represent...
...It's the filing system.
Most of Huanglong's libraries and databases still use this method to organize their archives. Namely, the Grand Libraries.
Yes. The large data repositories located in Huanglong's major cities.
Exactly. Languages may evolve, names may change, but time remains constant.
It's an elegant system, indeed.
The Academy's public archives are organized in this manner, too.

dialogs.content: The previous prototype almost met all our needs, but we're wondering if you can further optimize it.
Well... Um...
Make your feedback specific.
We find it a bit hard to use. It's heavy, and the engine doesn't work that well.
Can you reduce its weight by another ten percent and double the Tacetite Energy output?
I see, so you want a portable heavy tank. That's quite a BRILLIANT idea.
Yeah, you got me. There must be something you can do, right? Try to cut cost as much as you can, but you can invest in better materials to reduce the weight.
That's easy, but in order to cut costs, I need you to double my research budget.
What do you mean? How can we save money when the budget is doubled?
Oh? So, you do know doubling the budget won't lead to cost savings? Funny how you apply double standards when you're the one making requests.
Regarding the "good material" you asked for... Well, I see some right in front of me. You're the perfect material to be shipped off to the blacksmith's... for a good old-fashioned beating. Marvelous.
Trying to exhaust public research resources for personal gain at a time like this... You must think you're so smart.
You... You could just admit you can't do it! How dare you spew such insults in public?!
Oh, I apologize if you felt humiliated. I thought you must have a thick skin to present such an unreasonable request.
Besides, didn't I just tell you?
I can fulfill any request you may have, but that's gonna cost extra.
How... how dare you! We're divesting! I'm telling you! I'm leaving!
Interesting. Do you really think the meager investment you made over a decade ago is enough to make any difference? I've been paying more money every day to treat my colleagues to afternoon teas.

People in Huanglong have a good tradition of reciprocating help generously, and the Academy has been treating its investors with respect. You've already received a 120% return on your investment, haven't you?

I suggest you take what you can get. Blame your bad luck for crossing paths with me, the only foreigner here at the Academy. I don't plan to follow that "good tradition". I speak up when you get on my nerves. Farewell, you're free to leave.

dialogs.content: Why... doesn't make sense...
You seem very troubled... Are you okay?
You guys are the culprits!
It's all because you guys defeated the Crownless!
But isn't it a good thing that the Tacet Discord threatening Jinzhou has been eliminated?
Of course it's a good thing, but it happened to be the busiest time for us...
Because of the frequent Tacet Discord outbreaks, our Tacet Discord research department has been extremely busy lately, and now we have this large amount of materials to deal with.
I probably won't be able to sleep tonight...
I'm really sorry...
It's okay, I'm just venting. It's also our wish to uncover the secrets of the Crownless as soon as possible.
...You're right... Sigh, I'm just too frustrated, sorry. We need to figure out the new situation with the Tacet Discord as soon as possible, but we've been stuck for a while...
By the way, I heard that you didn't use the Terminal to access the frequency data of the Crownless, but absorbed it directly with your body?
Yes, from what we've seen, that's correct.
The process of transforming Tacet Discord into Echo is actually a process of reproducing frequency data with the Terminal.
So as long as we study the Echo obtained from the Resonators, it's basically the same as studying the original Tacet Discord.
But it's unheard of to absorb frequency data with the body like you did...
I guess you can't summon the Echo for now, what a pity!
It would have been such good research material... If it was absorbed through the Terminal, it would have reduced our workload by at least 70%, sigh.
But there's nothing we can do...
Yeah, that's why it's even more regrettable. Maybe the development of science always has to fight against these damn regrets.
Thank you for listening to my complaints... Ah, and thank you for defeating the threat to the Crownless.
The rest of this should be left to researchers like me. I'm going back to continue my work, goodbye.

dialogs.content: It's been three days.
We've both made it on time.
Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Jinhsi. It brings me great joy to see you, Rover.

To show up as a projection again would be ill-mannered of me. Please rest assured, it is a real human in the flesh you're speaking to. Despite Huanglong's advanced technology, such a realistic projection is still impossible.
Or perhaps you would like to verify it?
Jinhsi smiles genuinely and offers her hand to you, radiating calmness and sincerity.
...It is nothing to be concerned about.
An emergency forced me to leave, and I only had the time to prepare some tokens for you. Please pardon my lack of hospitality.
...Yes. The Sentinel of Jinzhou is currently absent.
Correct.
The Sentinels guide and guard humanity as a symbol of our civilization.
When a region's Sentinel goes absent, chaos is bound to ensue. As this news could lead to civil unrest, please keep it a secret.
Jinzhou's Sentinel, "Jué," is being held captive by the Fractsidus. I had to postpone our meeting and put all my effort into finding its whereabouts.
Yes, our thoughts are connected to a certain degree. I can sense its memories, feelings, and surroundings, though not very clearly.
Unfortunately, I haven't. I can feel Jué is in danger. The good news is, I have figured out the culprit behind all of this.
Precisely.
The Fractsidus plans to advance another Lament and cause disasters worldwide.
Overseer Scar had several objectives upon infilrtrating Jinzhou.
To track you down, to test your strengths, and to make you join their cause. To abduct Jué and to resurrect the Threnodian in advance.
They must have discovered your value, likely from one of Jué's prophecies. If you join them, they'll gain significant power.
Should you refuse to join, the Fractsidus will likely want to eliminate you so you don't get in their way.
I have a plan to apprehend Scar. Once we capture him, the Fractsidus won't be that much of a threat to you for the time being.
If you are willing to lend us a hand, I will ensure your safety during our cooperation.
Thank you for your trust, Rover.
Of course. Your decision is valued, Rover.
Speaking of which, you seem to have already gathered a lot from the tokens.
Impressive, Rover.
The threat Jinzhou is facing is far worse than meets the eye.
One of the Threnodians will soon be reawakened...
They are the enemies of human civilizations, born from the dark side of our collective consciousness. We must defeat them to protect all of humanity.
We have been doing our best to prevent the disaster, but the Fractsidus is accelerating the Threnodian's revival.
Indeed.
You have defeated the Crownless and absorbed its Echo with your bare hands. It is the Tacet Discord that embodies the concept of warfare.
Resentment of the fallen, fright of the ignoble... Those are the emotions that laid grounds for its birth.
The Crownless is a Tacet Discord that possesses powers from the reviving Threnodian.
Jinzhou is a border city with an unbreakable will and strong spirit of resistance. However, we also fear the constant wars and loss of life, and the Threnodian can prey on that.
You, however... You were able to defeat and absorb a Threnodian-related Tacet Discord with your bare hands, and resonate with other TDs.

Meanwhile, Huanglong's records mention a hero with similar powers who saved our nation during the Threnodian War. {Male=He;Female=She} is also mentioned in literature dating back to Jinzhou's establishment.
To uncover your true identity, this could be a helpful lead to pursue.
Yes. Based on my own deduction, and the prophecies of Jué.
You mean... The unfinished statue of Jué?
I see. Do you mind letting me know what you remembered? Since it's related to our Sentinel, I might be able to help.
You tell Jinhsi about the fragmented memories you were able to remember.
Rover, the memories of which you speak...
As I mentioned earlier, I can resonate with Jué, our Sentinel. Your recollections... They align with what I've witnessed in Jué's memories.
Yes, I do remember seeing something similar... I believe it had truly happened in the past.
In other words, you may be the person mentioned in our records.
The unwavering presence by our Sentinel's side, bonded by an unbreakable trust.
Resonators tend to have a longer lifespan, but it is indeed unprecedented to live hundreds of years without any sign of aging.
So many mysteries about you remain unsolved, and your age is just one of the unknowns.
Sorry, but I don't know. Jué's last piece of information pointed to the Norfall Barrens, where you should find the Threnodian.
I pray you will find your answers there.
A Threnodian is resurrecting, and our nation is in grave danger. This reminds me of the Threnodian War all too much. Perhaps... This has something to do with your mysterious appearance in Jinzhou?
Not really. I don't plan to believe in a hero showing up out of nowhere and protecting us.
I am just presenting whatever lead I have about your past, as I know it is troubling you. I want to help you, and that is all there is to it.
Thank you for considering lending us a hand. Your help is much appreciated, but please do not feel obligated because of the information I shared.
They are my people, and the responsibility to keep them safe should fall on no one else but my own shoulders.
I am saying this because I have faith in my abilities, and even more so in the bravery of Jinzhou's soldiers and our people.
You deserve to make your own decision about this after uncovering your true identity.
I appreciate everything you've done for us, during the past few days, or perhaps even longer ago.

Haha... So we agree already.

It's up to the two of us to make that ideal world a reality.

Is that the kind of ending you were hoping to hear?

Of course, as always. Life was the most valuable thing they had to offer.

They must have poured their sincerity into it, no doubt.

Nuh uh... Don't rush, Rover. Take your time.
What is the truth you've uncovered?

It was executed because its flock was deceived.
It survived along with all the other lambs.

dialogs.content: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock found out the truth but chose to be his accomplices, and they willingly offered the black lamb as another sacrifice.
Hahaha, that's right!

Almost there, Rover.

Pfft... Really? You're such a good little lamb. So innocent, so sweet.
Do you really believe a hero would show up and save the day?

I know I'm being naive, but there is someone out there in need of Lollo Logistics' service. Someone who believes that "We Promise, We Deliver"...

dialogs.content: Guess you won't need my self-introduction. Aww, I spent so much time on it.
Guess you won't need my self-introduction. Aww, I spent so much time on it.
People come and go, take a break, and rest your feet!
Soothe your throat with some Pu-er tea, or cool down with Laojun tea. Tea delights abound, and our menu's renowned.
Have some of our refreshing, iced sour plum juice. A treat for all ages you won't want to miss!
Hello there, fancy some tea? Step inside and take a seat.
Welcome to our tea house, where honesty is our policy. A sip for a coin, a treat for a bit more, and a tasting spree if you're ready to splurge!
Oh, you flatter me. If our customers are pleased, they'll better appreciate our tea.
That's right. It's popular in my hometown, and I've been interested in crosstalk and shouting-to-sell since I was a child.
I learned all this on my own, but I only have the courage to perform it here. It's my dream to be able to perform on the stage one day...
I know I still need to practice before realizing my dream, so I keep chatting with guests every day. It's a kind of practice for me. Well, hope they don't find me annoying.
Haha, did you reply to me that way on purpose? As if you were acting as a stooge.
Don't you think our conversation is like an improvised Xiangsheng? I must say, we did it quite well.
Please, have a seat here. It seems we've formed a connection, so I'll treat you to some sunflower seeds. It's on me.
No problem. When you have time, please come again.
Hahaha, that was some good crosstalk! I've got a bunch of jokes ready to go. When you have time, I'd love to share them with you.

I immediately followed it and saw the mouse hopping onto the shoulders of a little cat, sneaking into the shop through the window.

After the mouse left, I went to the cat and asked, "Why didn't you just catch the mouse and eat it?"

Isn't it amusing? A cat working for a mouse.

After the mouse left, I went to the cat and asked, "Why didn't you just catch the mouse and eat it?"
The cat glanced at me and said, "Fool. If there were no mouse stealing oil, why would they keep me? It's better to have a bit of oil every day for the long run."

If you don't believe it, why don't you take a look at the windowsill? There might be traces of oil left.

Well...

Don't be fooled by his modest disposition. He's actually my informant from the streets.

So I think something might have happened or someone's got their eyes on him. For his safety, I can't approach him directly.
I saw you shooting the breeze with him a few times before, so I figured maybe you could get close without blowing his cover?
Thank you. Just be careful, for both Yihu and yourself, not to blow your covers.

dialogs.content: Look! Someone is there!
Cough... water, water... Please...
Aah, right here. Drink, please.
I... I thought it was the end.
Did you place an order with Lollo Logistics?
Yes, I did. I'm Yuni. I didn't expect Lollo Logistics to really make it here. Thank you so much.
You're welcome. Maybe I should apologize... for not delivering your order on time.
I don't know. I woke up here, surrounded by toxic pollen with no way out. I was starving and parched, barely hanging on.
The Gravity Storm was messing with my signal... I tried calling everyone in my contacts, but only Lollo Logistics' number went through.
Hehe, of course it did! We've invested in strengthening our signal so that anyone can place orders with us anytime, anywhere.
I was worried about losing the signal, so I used your automatic ordering service to send out the request. I didn't expect you to actually deliver it here.
Absolutely! At Lollo Logistics, we always deliver on our promises, no matter what!
No need to trouble yourselves. I can move around now. Thanks so much... I'll never forget your help.
Wait, remember to spread the word about Lollo Logistics! We have discounts for new customers, you know!
Haha, I will. Goodbye for now!
Great, the order is finally done. It feels good to wrap this job up.
To be honest, I once thought it was no more than a publicity slogan, too. No one would really take each and every order so seriously, right?
But I changed my mind when I received a package delivered by Lollo Logistics. It was something my late father left.
Yes. He was a Midnight Ranger. I was told at a young age that he passed away at his post, and that his body was not even found.
The delivery guy said my father was injured in a battle against the TD Outbreaks. He was trying to protect his friends when he fell into a valley.
A Lollo Logistics employee found him, but they could not save him.
They told me that until his dying breath, he didn't stop thinking about me, saying that his daughter was about to turn ten, and he... he couldn't even see her one last time.
He hoped that Lollo Logistics would deliver the doll he carried with him as a birthday present to his daughter.
Yes, but it was far more complicated. Father passed before he could say the address and identity, and no identifications could be found with him by then.
However, couriers from Lollo Logistics didn't give up. They kept asking and investigating while they delivered other goods.
Finally, after all those difficulties, they found the girl. That girl was me.
But by the time I received this present, I was already over the age of playing dolls. It was my 18th birthday.
Lollo Logistics inspired me. I wanted to join and stick to the motto: We Promise, We Deliver!
Hehe, thank you.
One order done. Next up, we have a bigger order to deliver!

Father was seriously injured when he fell into a valley in the middle of a battle to cover his teammates, and all of his markings were lost and missing.
A passing Lollo Logistics employee found him, but in the end couldn't save him.
The father finally wanted Lollo Logistics to mail the hairpin he had on him intended as a gift for his daughter's 12th birthday, but died before he could give out the address.
This logistician didn't give up on this, investigating and asking questions all the way through the delivery of other goods, and eventually found out where I lived

That's why I aspire to be a part of Lollo Logistics, with the promise of "We Promise, We Deliver".
Now that the order is complete, let's go find Explosive Spear's parts.
The Woodrow newsletter says it has found the parts for the gun head. Want to come along?

dialogs.content: Madam Magistrate advised you to explore what these tokens represent during her absence. This may help you acquire the information you desire sooner.
I apologize for the inconvenience, but please rest assured: she will be here to meet you in three days' time.

content.content: How am I supposed to know what the tokens represent?

dialogs.content: Sorry... I cannot disclose her whereabouts at this time. Please trust me that she is eagerly looking forward to meeting you in person.
Pardon my inability to provide a better answer. Madam Magistrate has a task that she must handle alone, but she has never for one moment forgotten about her meeting with you.
Not knowing exactly when you'd arrive, she had to leave without having the chance to welcome you in person.
Because she will require at least three days to complete her current task.
Madam Magistrate wanted to assure you that in three days, by any means, she will return to meet you in person.
You...
I'll be sure to convey your kindness to Madam Magistrate. Please accept my sincerest gratitude.

Yes, Madam Magistrate does hope to have your assistance, but there is no rush for a decision. She does not want to pressure you into anything you may not desire. We invite you to learn about our situation before making a final commitment.
When it comes to these tokens, it is never her intention to confuse you with the puzzles. Instead, they should serve as clues that lead you toward the truth.
Madam Magistrate deeply regrets not having the time to deliver her messages to you in person.
We value your presence far more than you might imagine. The same goes for any and all information about you.

content.content: How were you certain I was the guest?

dialogs.content: Since Madam Magistrate is currently away, I cannot make the final confirmation on her behalf.
But you. You are truly exceptional.
Regarding that...
My eyes can see the frequencies of all living beings.
Or rather, those "frequencies" are the only thing I can see.
You... You share the same frequency with Madam Magistrate.
You look undistorted and authentic, in your original form.
Apologies. My description was not accurate.
Both you and Madam Magistrate look undistorted to me.
In my eyes, you appear the way you are.
They all look different.

I need your Terminal for Access Pass authorization. In the meantime, I will configure the latest Utility modules for you.

I will be here on standby, ready to assist whenever you need me.

People say he is a bit scary at first glance, but he's actually quite kindhearted once you get to know him...
Chixia told me he's quite popular with the kids. Children have been pestering him for all kinds of fancy toys, and he's always open to their requests.

dialogs.content: Here you are. The data we collected in the Gorges of Spirits has been submitted for analysis, and we'll have the results today. I have the equipment for your physical examinations ready, too.
Any discoveries during your trip to the City Hall?
You show Baizhi the tokens and tell her about what happened.
What do you think, Baizhi?
I have a hypothesis about the sugar pearl, but I need to verify it first. If possible, I recommend conducting non-destructive tests of all these tokens you have.
Data is always straightforward.

The first three tokens can be tested at <ano=Branch of Remnant Studies>my branch's laboratory</ano>. This miniature sundial will require radiographic testing, though. To access the necessary equipment, we'll need to file a request with one of the Tacetite studies related branches.

content.content: Tacetite... That's the field Mortefi specializes in, isn't it?
We can ask them about the other tokens too.

dialogs.content: Yes, Mortefi is the Branch of Tacetite Weaponry's head within the Department of Safety.
Indeed.
One moment, please.
Soon after, Baizhi returns with Mortefi.

Give me the items to be tested. Anything else you need me to know, you can let me know now. You may retrieve your items in twenty minutes, and the analysis report will be ready five minutes after that. Take a right, and you'll find me in the testing room.
Mortefi takes the sundial and gently weighs it in his hand.
This one looks like the early handiwork of someone I know.
It's lightweight, and its design differs from that of the typical sundial. And it appears to be missing a part. See, there's a groove here.

I don't see anything special with these items. Speaking of this sugar pearl... So you all remember eating sugar pearls like this when you were kids? I don't think I've ever had anything like this in my childhood.
No. I'm from the New Federation. You mean this sugar pearl might be unique to Huanglong?
I remember a nurse lady giving me a candy like that.
So, sugar pearls like this were distributed at hospitals? Perhaps...
The sugar pearl might be a type of medicine. Its sweet taste would've made it more palatable to children.
Ms. Baizhi. As a Huanglong local working at the Academy, I suppose you already had an idea about what it is?
I do have my theory as to what it is, but it still needs verification. I wouldn't proclaim any solid answers before confirming the chemical composition of this item with reliable data.

Life has never been easy after the Lament, but I still remember that sweetness from my childhood.

The battle against that epidemic in Jinzhou was grueling. Once infected, children either died or suffered life-long disabilities, Resonators or not. With Tacet Discords ravaging Jinzhou and severing all communication with other cities, desperation ran high.
Words are not enough to convey how desperate people must have felt. They resorted to self-experimentation with a newly developed vaccine, risking everything for a chance. If they failed...
We owe our presence here to those who came before us. It's important to remember their sacrifices.
If the sugar pearl points to the information and reports we have just read, what is Madam Magistrate trying to convey?
Is it related to your past? Or is it...
According to the reports, the vaccine's creator died three years after its development, with the rest of the team now over fifty.
You mean... You could be that infant shown in the footage?
They should be around your age by now.
Hmm... but {Male=he;Female=she} doesn't have your golden eyes...
But you are not from Jinzhou... Maybe the place you came from had a similar situation?

With this thought, perhaps, the reports about the sugar pearl are just one part of the clues. The other part telling your past and memories is hidden in the documents on the "Wei" shelf. What do you think?
A hero...
Are you saying that the information contained in the sugar pearl doesn't directly point to your identity?

The Battle of Gorge of Spirits was the catalyst to found Jinzhou. Tacet Discords were born in the Norfall Barrens and their invasion route was originally traceable. However, the emergence of the Crownless changed that route.
The Crownless is a Tacet Discord that embodies war itself. The hatred of the fallen warriors and the fear of the survivors are the ingredients for it.
In the limited information available, some researchers have speculated its connection with the Threnodian.

When it comes to the Threnodian, there is a lot to tell. For now, you can think of it this way: the Threnodian is the most powerful Tacet Discord. The Battle of the Threnodian that happened before was to fend it off.
According to the reports, the Crownless is very similar to the formidable Tacet Discord we encountered.
Our Sentinel, Jué, manifested before us in that battle.
We have the symbol "Wei" now. This should go with the time part.
But we can't yet solve the puzzle with this alone.
Maybe we can figure out the cardinal direction part by looking into the tokens again. It might have something to do with how we got one of the clues.
What do you think, Rover?

But her policies have proven effective and greatly benefited us since she took office.
Some believe that the remarkably far-sighted and profound decisions were actually devised by Counselor "Changli", due to the young age of the Magistrate.
Lady Changli is our Magistrate's advisor and former teacher. She once held a high position in the Central Secretariat, but she requested a transfer to Jinzhou.
I've also heard about rumors painting her as a cunning manipulator rather than a loyal servant...
You seem to hold Madam Magistrate in high regard.

Let's look back on what we've gathered so far: Our clues point to the sugar pearl as a key in solving the sundial's puzzle.
Simply put, one token can lead to multiple targets and one target may hold several pieces of information.

In other words, there are people who need to be misled, and they may obtain these tokens.

Long story short, it’s a sweet deal for you. I’ll make sure you’re happy with what you get.

I guess you must be Rover?

Measure the planet with your own feet, and witness civilizations through your own eyes.
Let's go explore the world together!
Allow me to make a brief introduction.

Our core mission at the Pioneer Association is to push the boundaries of humanity's understanding through exploration. We ignite curiosity and embrace a trailblazing mindset, inviting adventurers from all backgrounds to join us.
Our team consists of top journalists, writers, photographers, and expeditioners from around the world.
Pioneers are free to plan their own expeditions with our support, and we offer platforms for publishing high-quality content such as magazines, podcasts, and books.
Our Pioneers earn cash for submissions, plus dedicated funding for approved expedition plans from the Association.
Pioneers also have the opportunity to receive special outdoor tools essential for their journeys. As they venture further, these tools can become invaluable aids in exploration.
Great! I'll get your profile set up real quick. You'll be able to check your exploration process so far on your Terminal at any time.

New customers can buy one and get one 50% off!
We publish two periodicals actually. Wutherium Geographic for general readers, and Post-Lament Anthropocene for academics.
If you're interested in subscribing to our magazines, tell me now and we’ll send the latest issues to your doorstep every month!
For adventurers looking for top-notch entertainment, our Pioneer Podcast has it all. The Podcast is free, and there's also an Insider Channel for paid subscribers.
With diverse shows covering news, music, and science, there's something for everyone.
The Insider Channel features updates on ongoing explorations by contracted reporters and seasoned explorers.
Let me know if you'd like to subscribe!
Oops, Gulpuff plushies sold out... Want me to reserve one for you?
Anyway, you can always reach out for help on your journey. The Pioneer Association is here for you through any obstacles!

Hoohoo.

dialogs.content: Jianxin explains why she wants to leave the city. She tells you about the person she is looking for.
So you're looking for the relative of a veteran, and you believe he's in the Midnight Rangers camp in Desorock Highland?
Exactly.

content.content: What's your relationship with the person you're looking for?
Why is it so important for you to find him?
Do you know anything about the mangosteen?

dialogs.content: His name is Zhiyuan. I don't know him in person. On my way down the mountain, I ran into his grandfather, who was looking for his grandson on his own but ended up lost.
I couldn't just leave an elderly person like him out there. So I thought I'd escort him to the nearest city and make further plans once we're safe.
You're willing to go to such lengths for someone you don't know...
You have a kind soul, Master Jianxin.
It's all thanks to many kind-hearted people. Without them, Mr. Zongye and I wouldn't have made it to Jinzhou.
Mr. Zongye seemed confused. He's gone through a lot searching for his enlisted grandson. Lending a helping hand was the least I could do.

I reported his situation to the Patrol Station, but with the chaos on the frontline, Mr. Zongye has been extremely worried about his grandson's safety... He'd sneak out to look for his grandson the moment no one was watching. I'm really worried about him.
This mangosteen?
It's got some fresh-looking leaves, soft springy skin, and eight fleshy segments fully ripened inside. It looks like a nice fruit.
Oh, one more thing I forgot to mention. There's a bruise at the bottom. If you don't eat that part soon, it'll spoil.
I grew up in my sect on a mountain. Spent most of my time training with my masters.
One day, I was told training in seclusion was not enough. I must engage with the world to further my skills.
So I started my self-cultivating journey. I've been to various cities and gained valuable lessons, but there is still so much more to learn.
...According to what I've gathered, Mr. Zongye's grandson is very likely in the Desorock Highland.
Thanks to your help, I can finally leave the city to find him.
Of course.

dialogs.content: Master Jianxin, have you found the person you're looking for?
Yes, I've found Zhiyuan. We will return to the city with the logistics team. We will go find Mr. Zongye to let him know he is safe.
Zhiyuan is a man full of courage. Influenced by his veteran grandpa's tales, he longs to join the military and aid in humanity's battle against Tacet Discords.
The journey with you has exposed me to immense suffering, but the battles on the frontline must be even more brutal than what I've witnessed.
Countless lives have been lost in this war...
Master Rongfu once told me, "The best sages gain enlightenment in the military, the mediocre sages gain enlightenment in the bustling cities, and the worst sages gain enlightenment in seclusion."
I do share some of Zhiyuan's feelings.

However, Zhiyuan disagreed with the intense training and tests required to join the military. He saw no distinction between ordinary people and Resonators, and believed he could contribute on the battlefield, however small that contribution might be.

I, too, found what Zhiyuan said was reasonable to an extent, and I couldn't change his mind with words. So I tried to imagine what my masters would do. They'd set up a spar in this case. And if I won, they'd let me do what I wanted.
I didn't mean to beat him up for nothing. My masters taught me valuable lessons through sparring, and I gained important insights from those fights. Now, who do you think won that fight?
"The shape changes, but not the forms; the more it moves, the more it yields. Less thinking, more knowing. Simplify for clarity.”

He realized how he was just trying to convince himself that he could make a difference, not wanting to acknowledge his own limitations. Fighting on the battlefield requires physical and mental strength, and he was not yet prepared for that.
"All tangles untied, all glare tempered, all dust smoothed. It is like a deep pool that never dries. ” How true! I've come to understand this line more.

title: 剧情_遗落原乡_剧场_二级POI任务_4_1

content.content: It's not safe for you to be standing here.

dialogs.content: Aah! You scared me!
*sigh* Guess I was just too worried.
Look in the distance. See that valley? There's an abandoned music theater in the middle of it.
My uncle. He went down there all by himself.
Ugh. Tell me about it.
The area's been abandoned for years. Who knows what kind of stuff might be down there.
Wouldn't be surprised if you get crushed by a falling boulder or even have a building fall on top of you.
But that stubborn old man. He even swung his fists at me when I told him I was going to go along with him...
Oh, you have no idea how stubborn that old man of ours can be at home. Especially with that temper of his.

At home, whatever he says goes. Not to mention he's also known in the field for being a wacko and a pain in the butt to get along. Musicians on the receiving end of his temper and harsh critiques are a common thing.
My uncle became a renowned composer in the field at young age.
Don't know what's gotten him worked up a few days ago after he saw a random news report.
Everyone in the family couldn't talk him out of coming all the way here, and now he's just left me here...
Yeah. It's one of those boring rumor ghost stories. The kind that even kids wouldn't fall for.
It's headlines went something like: "Abandoned Theater in the Rain— A Piano Plays Without it's Performer."
*sigh* I think his age is finally catching up to him...
Really? That would be great. No wonder my uncle always talks about how the people of Jinzhou are so kind and warm-hearted. Guess it's all true.
I was really stuck between a rock and a hard place. If he saw me going after him, he'd freak out for sure.
Plus with his heart condition and all... Thank you. As long as you can find him and make sure he's safe, then that's good enough for me!

Jinzhou is a border city of Huanglong. The people here are tenacious and optimistic. Thus the music they create are also grand and majestic, full of vigor.
