dialogs.content: It's simple, really. If we create a macroscopic node with Resonator A, we can use that as the coordinate to perform a three-dimensional expansion through inverse anisotropic frequency...
So you want us to build a three-meter-tall marble control station from your model?
No, no, I said three-dimensional expansion. It means, uh, taking apart the model's original four-dimensional structure...
You need a four-legged stand, too? No problem. It can all be done as long as we have the blueprint.
{PlayerName}! I was just telling this gentleman here about our latest project, but he... seems to be proposing a bolder, more profound approach.
To be honest, some of the suggestions are quite inspirational, like the four-directional magnetic restraint he mentioned, despite the lack of practical proof...
(Thank heavens you're here, {PlayerName}...)
(Frankly, it's like a foreign language to me, except he's not a foreigner.)
Do you know each other, {PlayerName}?
Oh, right, I remember now. Pardon me. I've been knee-deep in the new project...
Phew... Thanks, {PlayerName}. Now we can finally get back to business.
You must be the hunter we hired to collect Scarefrost Deer samples, right?
Huh?
Ha.. haha... Oh, is that so? Oh right... I think I did mention something like that.
Actually, we've been working on a new project that mainly focuses on the impact of the Sentinel's time barrier on Mt. Firmament's ecology.
As you can tell, even though the time barrier is gone, the residual effect caused the snow to be permanent, leading to the unique ecology you have now.
The environment may appear stable now, but who can guarantee it won't collapse or become disastrous for Mt. Firmament in a few years or decades?
The people of Hongzhen believe that Sentinel's power has seeped into the rocks of Mt. Firmament.
Therefore, comparing the frequencies of the rocks of Mt. Firmament to those from other areas could give us a clue to what's really going on.
Ahem... but there's a... big hurdle.
We're running out of budget. It's the director's fault. No matter how miraculous Mt. Firmament is, we just can't afford all these projects at once...
So... can you give me a discount? Please, the future of Mt. Firmament is at stake.
But what I'm offering is already really low... We still have to haul the stones all the way from Jinzhou, and we might even run into Tacet Fields on the way...
This is a very crucial study, so please...
What, me...?
But I... I can't make the call. I'm a nobody... I'm not even a professional salesman.
*sigh* I must be out of my mind... Fine, I'll sell them to you at cost price.
Really? That's wonderful! I'll put in a budget request right now!
This probably isn't going to work out for me... The boss might fire me on the spot when I get back.
I don't know. But they seemed so passionate... and committed.
I looked into the research station before I came. They declined generous offers in Jinzhou and other places to work in these makeshift conditions.
I don't understand exactly what they're studying, but I know it's important.
Thank you, {PlayerName}. I feel much better now.
I'm still a little bummed-out about it, though... It took me so long to get to this point.
Hope so.

title: 剧情_1_1_每日_虹镇地推大使_12_1

dialogs.content: Hey, it's you, {PlayerName}. Come, grab a drink.
I totally screwed everything up. These past few days have been a complete waste of time. I barely made any money, and I haven't been able to get a foothold in the market at all.
My transfer order should come through any day now. After that I'll be back in Jinzhou explaining to my boss how I messed everything up.
Brrring brrring...
Excuse me, {PlayerName}, I have to take this.
Yongxin has a brief exchange with a client through his Terminal. Though a bit nervous, you can see a true salesman emerging right before you.

content.content: ...So, did you just land a big deal?

dialogs.content: Yeah... I really didn't expect that.
He said he's a merchant from Mengzhou looking to invest in tourism around Mt. Firmament.
The mountain passes around Hongzhen have long fallen into disrepair and are no longer suitable for travel, so he plans to buy some stones and pave them up.
He actually did not consider buying from us at first, but he happened to meet that researcher in Hongzhen on a business trip.
After learning we supplied a batch of stones at a low price to support the scientific effort in Hongzhen, he seemed to think that demonstrated... a certain quality of our company.
True. Good things tend to happen to good people, perhaps?
I'm glad I made the right call that day, all thanks to you, Rover.
For as long as I can remember, whether it was my family, teachers or colleagues, no one believed I could achieve anything.
They would leave the most menial, insignificant jobs to me and never ask for my opinions.
If it weren't for you, who were willing to put faith in me and believe that even someone like me could do it...
I don't think... I would have never had the courage to make a decision.
I'm probably just too excited because I finally got a big deal.
But I meant everything I just said.
Okay, things are going to get busy from now. Thanks for helping me out, {PlayerName}.
I learned a lot over the past few days. I feel like I'm ready to handle any sales opportunity that comes my way.
That's right. But once you succeed, it's much easier the second time around...
Oh, I gotta run back to Jinzhou. There's this big deal waiting for me to take care of.
Thank you, Rover. I'll definitely be the greatest stone salesman in all of Jinzhou when we meet again!

dialogs.content: Kneel before these brave pioneers who paved the way for our enlightenment.
You've tainted your blade with their blood... Join us, and together we'll forge a path to a new world. Let go of your stubborness already.
Kneel before these brave pioneers who paved the way for our enlightenment.
You've tainted your blade with their blood... Join us, and together we'll forge a path to a new world. Let go of your stubborness already.
...The Weiqi pieces were scattered, but the guru remained calm. "It's getting late," he said gently to the woodcutter. "Shouldn't you be heading down the mountain?"

As he glanced at the sky, the woodcutter was shocked to see how much time had passed. "It couldn't have been more than two hours," he thought in disbelief. Feeling apologetic, he prepared to leave, worried that the guru would be annoyed with him.

But when the woodcutter turned around, he nearly jumped out of his skin. The hermit guru, who had been playing Weiqi and drinking wine, was now gone. In his place lay a shattered Weiqi board and a heap of decaying bones.
The woodcutter was so scared that he dropped his bamboo basket and ran down the mountain without even looking back.

As he reached the mountain's base, he was hit with a stark realization. The quaint village he remembered had bloomed into a bustling town, with sturdy brick houses replacing the humble thatched cottages. And where his home once stood, only an empty wasteland remained.
He noticed a date on the calendar that he had never seen before. In shock, he grabbed a passerby and urgently asked, "Excuse me, can you tell me the current date and time?"
As he heard the answer, his legs went weak. Everything had changed—time had passed and his loved ones were gone. No one remembered him anymore.
So the woodcutter left Mt. Firmament, but how was he still alive and kicking? With a hundred year's worth of time inside him, shouldn't he...
Your story... It's a bit far-fetched, don't you think? I mean, if I wasn't from Hongzhen, I might have fallen for it.
...Well! That's the whole point. The truth is stranger than fiction, my friend. Every detail in that story is based on real events.
Let me share with you the other legend of Mt. Firmament, for deep within its sacred peaks lies a powerful secret... the "Secret of Immortality"!

We all know that Mt. Firmament is the abode of the Sentinel, gathering spiritual energies from both heaven and earth for countless eons. Over time, even the mountain itself has taken on the form of our majestic Sentinel!
Living in the mountains for long stretches of time, surrounded by fresh air and drinking from nature's own bounty, can add years to one's life span!
It all starts with that game of Weiqi, one that the woodcutter stumbled upon. Too bad those secrets have been long forgotten...
Gather around now, people. You're in for the story of a lifetime...
Shh...
...I'll see you there.
*yawn* What's with the ruckus... Huh, what’s that in your hands?
Hmm... "Behold Hongzhen in its entirety, next to a ring and hanging eaves. When eternal snow thaw into flowing streams, let us reconvene."
Ooh... I see, I see...
I see I've got no clue at all!
I get the very last part, at least! She’s asking you out! Well that's a fancy way to write stuff...

content.content: According to the description, it's somewhere in Hongzhen.

dialogs.content: And now... this next sentence, "eternal snow thaw into streams"... What is that supposed to mean?
How did you manage to get all that hidden meaning?
But the buildings in Hongzhen all look pretty much the same. Which one exactly was she talking about?
Makes sense. Lead the way!

"When snow thaw into streams"? Ah, you’re not from around here, I bet? When we say that in Hongzhen, we mean the <ano=Time Period>Shichen</ano> of Wei. Early afternoon, the warmest hours of a day.

Legend tells of a visitor who ventured here some centuries ago. Back then, local villagers were struggling with no firewood due to heavy snow. This visitor opened up a path with their Forte and diverted a hot spring to provide warmth and aid.

People say it was once a stunning sight, with mist and ice flowing westward down the streams, as if many celestial beings were returning to the sea. Now the sight has unfortunately disappeared, but the saying sticks. We use it to describe time in local speech.
Well, it's what Grandpa Zou tells everyone. I haven't seen it with my own eyes, but when it comes to stories like this one... They're usually made-up.
Oh please, I'm only repeating what I've heard from him. He's been on a roll with his stories lately. But let's not take them too seriously, they're just for entertainment.

content.content: You don't believe in those stories?

dialogs.content: Hmm... Not that I don't want to believe them, but... Oh, you were listening to one of his stories earlier too, right? What did you think?
Really? So you're into stories and anecdotes too?
Looks like we have that in common.
Haha... Maybe Grandpa Zou can learn a thing or two from you in terms of humor.

Grandpa Zou's great-grandfather was a descendant of the first inhabitants of Hongzhen. He grew up hearing stories about Mt. Firmament. Recently he heard Madam Magistrate had resolved the crisis, so he decided to visit and learn more about his roots.

People in town are curious about the outside world and how they are perceived. Grandpa Zou is happy to answer their questions and has unknowingly become popular among them. Before he knew it, everyone was coming to talk to him...
It's funny to hear outsiders describe my hometown, Hongzhen, as mysterious. We're just a normal place with our own quirks...

Especially lately, with so many people from Jinzhou coming on some kind of expedition. They're obsessed with us, like we're some kind of ancient relics. Can you believe they actually asked if our Pavo Plums have magical powers?
Time truly is a formidable force...

If I were you, I'd steer clear of her. She's a deceitful woman who enjoys toying with people's hearts. A cunning villain who will manipulate you without you even knowing it.
Haven't you heard? She left her government job to come here, to this small town. There's gotta be a reason behind it.
I heard she chose to quit her job, but I bet she messed up back in the capital and got demoted here as punishment.

Then I guess you've also been fooled by her looks. That woman will stop at nothing to get what she wants, while you remain oblivious to her true intentions. And by the time you catch on, you'll already be caught in her trap.

Hmph... I say you're underestimating Changli's trickery.
I... I have my reasons to believe so!
I heard she tricked that VIP guest of Jinzhou into going to Mt. Firmament. Just think about how dangerous that place was!

She must have been afraid of {Male=him;Female=her} getting too close to Madam Magistrate and ruining her plans... What a sinister woman! Fortunately, that guest was a skilled fighter, and {Male=he;Female=she} managed to escape unharmed.

I can't help but feel envious. I wish I could speak to her like you did, but she refuses to do interviews with the Pioneer Association. Plus, I doubt we have anything in common to talk about anyway.
Of course! Everyone in Jinzhou knows about Lady Changli, even though she rarely appears in public.

Rover?
Nice to see you again. How are you liking Hongzhen so far?

*chuckle* Of course.
We're all indebted to you, Hongzhen and its people alike. If there's anything you need, don't hesitate to ask.
I couldn't help but notice you've been asking around. Is there something you need assistance with?
(Xinyi and Changli have a mutual trust as acquaintances. It should be fine to ask Xinyi instead...)

...I see.
...Apologies. I heard about your memory loss. Please pardon me.
There is a local tale about the "Secret of Immortality" being hidden on Mt. Firmament. Have you heard about it?
Yes. I have a slightly different version of this tale to share.
Centuries ago, a Taoist cultivator met an enigmatic visitor on Mt. Firmament. Despite their age difference, they soon became friends and often played Weiqi together.

One day, a woodcutter stumbled upon them, having lost his way home. Their game mesmerized him so much that he didn't notice the red tie on his basket rotting away… Panicked, he bumped into the Weiqi board.

Despite the interruption, the visitor remained unfazed. They offered the woodcutter some tea, then guided him down the mountain, shielding him from dangerous Temporal Disruptions. After that, the visitor disappeared.
Many years later, the Taoist cultivator became a legendary hermit guru. Upon returning to Mt. Firmament in his final years, he reunited with that elusive visitor.
The two resumed their unfinished game. People believe the visitor shared their Secret of Immortality through cleverly-placed Weiqi pieces, as a final parting gift.
Yes... and no. This game is missing the final twenty moves. It is unfinished.
That was a bit different from what you heard before, I guess? The story changed over time, infused with fantasy in each retelling.
But that's how old tales go, slowly losing their truth as they're passed down.
Precisely.
The legend may be shrouded in myth, but that game of Weiqi was real. Embedded within its records lies a cryptic message: "This game record can solve the crisis of time."

From what I know, only the Sentinel in its prime has the power to manipulate time through its possession of a complete Temporal Mandate. For us mere mortals, controlling time is indeed similar to gaining immortality.
As the records state, it only reveals itself when Mt. Firmament emerges. But how it ties to the Temporal Mandate remains an enigma... at least for now.
Yes. We may find a way to heal them.
If that is the case, we’ll be able to heal the Sentinel's wounds.
But... our chances are looking slim. That game record could just hold my teacher's memories, not any real value.
So I am presenting this as merely a personal request.
I am planning to go find that record. Could you please join me?
Thank you for lending me a hand. I promise it will be worth your while.
As we have been to Mt. Firmament before, I imagined it would pique your interest, as the tale concerns our Sentinel.
And, moreover... You are special to me, and… to Mt. Firmament. I hope I have provided enough reasons to clear your doubts.
I asked you about the unfinished Weiqi game, because I believe it may have something to do with your past.
Yes… After all, it takes two to play Weiqi, right?
If my speculation is correct… That game of Weiqi may hold clues to your lost memories.
In addition… I promise to aid you in any way I can after we return with the record. How does that sound?
Splendid.
Very well. Let's meet on the gallery road outside Hongzhen.
I still have some preparations to do. Please go ahead, I'll join you later.

But if you keep it all to yourself... No one, even those closest to you, will know how you really feel.
...Yes. I understand.
{PlayerName}, things are taking a turn. We should probably tell Lady Xinyi first.
What brings you here at this time of the day?
You explain the events that have transpired.
I see. Strange appearances of Tacet Discords in the mountains, and undiscovered Temporal Disruptions...
There are several questionable details according to {PlayerName}'s description.
What do you make of Fuling's words from earlier, Rover?

He claimed to have spent only half a day in the mountains, but it's been seven days since he returned to Hongzhen... That does sound like some kind of Temporal Disruption, one that wasn't strong enough to affect Hongzhen.
After Jinhsi's battle with the Sentinel, she ordered Midnight Rangers to patrol Hongzhen and inspect Mt. Firmament for any lingering Temporal Disruptions before reopening it to the public.
{PlayerName}, you've been exploring the mountains lately, so I'm sure you have a good grasp on Mt. Firmament. But if there are any hidden disruptions we missed...
Precisely. Yet... Why did it reappear at this point?
Fuling's "legend" differs from the situation at Mt. Firmament we're familiar with. In that tale, mortals were spared the cost of losing years from their lives.
He was utterly convinced of his discovery, and he somehow managed to run into Temporal Disruptions in half a day’s time. Also… when I questioned him, he evaded my inquiries.
Lies that are most challenging to detect aren't usually outright falsehoods, rather they hide parts of the truth.
The explorer wanted to save his friend indeed, but he was also hiding something.
...I've become rather curious about the truth behind this "Temporal Disruption."
Did you notice something, {PlayerName}?
For someone with a terminal illness, they should hold onto any chance of survival—no matter how slim... Is that what you think?
Maybe she's come to terms with her destiny, or maybe... she never planned on continuing to live like that forever.
Changli...
...Well, please pardon my baseless speculations.
I knew you'd notice too.
The frequency disturbance here is weak. It's similar to past Temporal Disruptions at Mt. Firmament, but not exactly the same.
Master Xuanmiao's records show that this is where the game record last appeared. This is also where we found that explorer.
... As Changli mentioned, this anomaly may indeed have something to do with that legendary game record.
Exactly... If this were to be the case, then we are not the only ones searching for its whereabouts.
The explorer did not tell us about his source of information.
But his knowledge of Mt. Firmament far exceeds that of a first-time visitor.
You mean...
Got it. The Midnight Rangers will block all entrances to the mountain for now. And Changli, you still have the power to send in garrison troops as needed.
We left Mt. Firmament in a hurry. I need to go back up the mountain and investigate further... I have some theories that could use confirmation.
We're still unsure about the exact location and range of the Temporal Disruption. Regardless, its reappearance is a pressing issue that needs our attention.
It may get dangerous.
Well then... Thank you, {PlayerName}.
Thank you again for your help. You were supposed to be here for a relaxing time... but it seems another crisis has popped up.
Do take extra caution.

Fuling has come to terms with her impending death. She doesn't buy into the legends of "immortality." Instead, she simply wants to make the most of the time she has left and fulfill her and Wuli's dreams together.
If Wuli wants to reach that so-called "paradise," he'll be trapped inside forever. It also means he'll have to give up his entire future as an explorer.
That is not what she wants for him.
Her ultimate desire is for her lover to embrace her inevitable passing, and to realize the joint aspirations they hold in her place.
She hasn't given up, but rather clings to hope for their future, even if she won't be there to see it unfold.
Hmm...? Why the sudden question?
Is that how you see me? Hmm... Perhaps for some, death is just a destination. There are more significant things to focus on.
I'm just making an educated guess from what we've collected. And honestly, Fuling isn't exactly good at keeping things to herself.
Let's stay focused on the issue. While the diary is cryptic, it still exposes the true intentions of whoever misled Wuli.
It's no coincidence. All the clues point to a correlation between the Temporal Disruption and the legends of the Weiqi game. Or maybe... someone's trying to make us connect the dots.
Yes. Information on the actual powers of Jué... This isn't the kind of information an ordinary explorer can obtain.
I guess our "old friends" have still not given up.
They went to great lengths just to lead us here. It would be rather rude of us to not respond in some way.

...The place we're looking for should be just ahead.

Please, no need to be so modest. I can tell the difference between our skill levels.
...This is my master's voice. The voice of the other person seems deliberately erased.

A new city is about to be established. Having accomplished so much, why do you choose to retire now?

*cough*... Well played. Even after twenty years, I still have no chance of winning against you.
Haha... I barely noticed how so much time has passed.
Every move in Weiqi is fluid and unpredictable. Even if we start with the same opening, the outcome can never be predetermined... We see this in our game, and it's true for all the lives out there.
My clan are a group of hermits. We view the world as a game of strategy, manipulating the ebb and flow behind the scenes...
But you, my friend, chose to enter the game yourself. It's a dangerous path with no end in sight. I want to help, but my time is running out. I won't be there when you finally succeed...
Please don't feel sad for me. If I die, it would be an honor to rest at the Sentinel's feet.
When the time comes... the one who shall finish this game of Weiqi with you will not be me, but rather my apprentice.
Do my plans seem too risky to you?
No need for concern. With her intelligence and quick thinking, she'll surely be able to solve this puzzle.
The result of this game will decide the fate of Jinzhou, and even the entire world.

Sorry, but you're not getting past me.
Jué's formidable time-bending abilities, at their peak... All trapped within this Sonoro Sphere, as I'm sure you are well aware.
Do you really want to chase after this legend when you don't even know if it's real?
So what? Wouldn't it be a sight to behold as this Sonoro Sphere consumes everything in its path, while the Temporal Disruptions bring death?
Anyway... {PlayerName}, thank you for letting us into this Sonoro Sphere.
You are indeed very special, as the Excellency foretold.

Wuli, this is the miracle we've been waiting to see! It's hope reborn after destruction...
Fuling...
It's over.
Did you find what you were looking for?
Thank you for your help. The Midnight Rangers have successfully apprehended all remaining Fractsidus members in the mountains, and the effects of the Temporal Disruption have now vanished.
I lost all contact with you during this whole time. Did you run into any trouble?
Temporal Disruption hidden inside a Sonoro Sphere... It makes sense now why it stayed hidden for so long.
I never thought the solution would be to burn down the entire Sonoro Sphere from the inside...
You went too far back there, Changli.
I know my limits.
Rover, Lady Changli...
Wuli is fine now, thanks to his doctor's help. As for me... Well, at least I can still walk a bit.
After all, it's been almost five days...
I never properly thanked you for bringing me back to Hongzhen. I heard about the attack by the Fractsidus in the mountains. I... I'm so sorry...
*chuckle* No need for that. I understand.
The Fractsidus had their eyes on the same thing as we did. They've been planning an ambush on us for a long time. Why would we blame it on you?
We will never forget how you saved us. You gave us the opportunity to witness such a breathtaking sight. Thanks to your help, this journey holds no regrets for me.
As for the truth behind the so-called Secret of Immortality... Fuling has told me everything.
I had a gut feeling it would turn out to be a disappointment, but I couldn't give up. And in the end, I lost sight of why I even started this journey...
...But this isn't the first time this has happened. Let's just call it another adventure coming to an end.
I've talked about it with Fuling. From now on, I'll take her on more trips to see more new places together.
Until...
Until the day... when I can no longer hold a pen. I've already talked to the folks at the publishing house, and they're happy to let me continue painting for them.
My eventual departure may be unavoidable, but I want to give it my all until the very end.
I know you have already looked past death, but remember... There are people who care about you. They want you to live on and be happy.
Yes, I understand. Sometimes, I wish...
...we could stay together a little longer, if only for a while...
Of course, Fuling, I... We've always been...
It's not time to be sad yet, is it?
I've compiled a list of renowned doctors in Huanglong. They're highly skilled and may offer assistance for your medical condition, which is challenging but not impossible to cure.
Lady Changli, I truly can't thank you enough...
No need for thanks.
Hmm... If you're feeling generous and want to repay me, I hope to see Fuling's work in the next issue of "Artists of Huanglong".
Everyone's been missing seeing their favorite landscape artist's work lately.
Are you surprised? Well, now I'm curious. What kind of a person do you see me as?
Now that the situation has been resolved, you should return to Hongzhen. You deserve some good rest.
After going through so much, you must be exhausted, {PlayerName}.
Me? Well, I think Lady Xinyi could use the extra help with dealing with the aftermath.
Well, It wouldn't hurt to have a little more faith in me, {PlayerName}.

Two days have passed since Changli told me that she and Xinyi would handle the aftermath. I wonder how she's doing...
Are you worried? Let's just go ask her then.
Might as well. Changli can be difficult to find. Let's go ask Xinyi first.

{PlayerName}, greetings.
We're almost done dealing with the aftermath of the previous incident. We're currently questioning the remaining Fractsidus members we caught at Mt. Firmament.

They wanted to get their hands on the Temporal Program from the legend of the Weiqi game, with the intention of unleashing chaos in Mt. Firmament once again. But thanks to you and Changli, their plans were foiled.
Changli recounted to us that a Fractsidus Overseer had entered the Sonoro Sphere and was injured by her fire. They were lucky to escape, but have not been seen since.
I've put together a thorough report for City Hall. We will strengthen our defenses to make sure this doesn't happen again.
We parted two days ago on the coast, and then she returned to Jinzhou.
Perhaps she's just taking some time to rest and recover... It must have taken a lot out of her to summon that much fire at once.
Changli knew you’d be worried, and she wanted me to relay this message to you...
Meet her at the pavilion on Mt. Firmament. She'll be waiting for you there.
She also said... No more riddles this time.

Aww. Can't you see I'm perfectly fine, sitting right in front of you?
Don't worry, {PlayerName}. We are only having a casual conversation today. Nothing taxing.
Besides, you only agreed to join me here for more questions, right?
Oh, is that so? I'm curious then.
Sure, ask away. I'm happy to answer them to the best of my ability.
It all started a century ago, when my mentor, Master Xuanmiao, had a brief encounter with a certain peculiar visitor.

During a TD Outbreak, my master was rescued by that individual. {Male=He;Female=She} exuded a unique energy and was always elusive. My master dug through ancient texts and unearthed {Male=his;Female=her} presence in long-forgotten history.
After searching for several years, he finally met that person on Mt. Firmament again. They played a game of Weiqi together, and that was how the legendary game record came into being.
At first, I thought my master meant the game record held actual information about the time crisis. But it was just a clue. The real key was finding you, the person behind it all.
And lastly, the Secret of Immortality... It's most likely just the woodcutter's own spin on the tale.

My master and the mysterious "visitor" had set a trap with the Sonoro Sphere, using the Weiqi game as a guise. They hid it with the Court of Savantae's Chronosorters, and it would only activate once the time flow on Mt. Firmament was restored to its normal state.

Despite the Sentinel and Mt. Firmament being saved, the Fractsidus would not go down without a fight. They were convinced that the Temporal Mandate was hidden within the game of Weiqi, but little did they know, they had already fallen into a trap.
Pure coincidence or the calculated workings of the Fractsidus, the explorer stumbled upon the Weiqi board, setting off its defense mechanisms.
The Sentinel was already damaged when it arrived here. My master had foreseen the disasters that would befall Mt. Firmament, so he created this mechanism as a precautionary measure.
The Sonoro Sphere would devour all who attempted to enter, unless they knew the solution to that puzzle.
Precisely.
The only way to escape was by burning the Sonoro Sphere without hurting anyone inside. It required masterful control of Forte. Thinking back, it was probably his ultimate test for me.
That was his first goal with this Sonoro Sphere.
Before leaving, Master entrusted me with a mission: To find that individual... The one who played Weiqi with him. The one who left behind that game record.
After my master's passing, {Male=he;Female=she} would be the only one who could control the Sonoro Sphere. By now, you should know who {Male=he;Female=she} is.
Yes.
That's why you needed me as your Wayfinder.
My master often mentioned you before his passing.
And from the moment you arrived in Jinzhou, I had my suspicions about your true identity. Our journey to Mt. Firmament solidified my beliefs.
And finally, the Weiqi board in that Sonoro Sphere sealed the truth for me.
Indeed... Those memories... They were all real.

content.content: I assume that was a younger version of you?

dialogs.content: Yes... That's all in the past, just a little homeless girl with no name.
I never thought we could make new memories in the Sonoro Sphere, where only the past repeats itself.
A moment of companionship and protection meant everything to me.
I can sense your unspoken question. Did I sacrifice my life when I burned down the Sonoro Sphere, like when I was a child?
What I told you there was true. But I've grown and gained control over my powers. Using my Forte now won't harm me in any way. Of that you can rest assured.
Also... If you really are the legendary person who changed the course of history, then you are perhaps the closest to immortality aside from our Sentinel.
We mortals come and go, our lives are full of meetings and goodbyes. Our time on this earth is fleeting compared to yours. So don't let it bother you.
I see. Perhaps this is why... It's so hard to leave this beautiful world behind.
Then... Would you be willing to finish that game of Weiqi with me instead?
How are you feeling, {PlayerName}? Well-rested, I hope.
Aww. Can't you see I'm perfectly fine, sitting right in front of you?

Apparently... this little one is what we had detected before. It’s the speculated "Space" or "Organism" hidden inside your body. Now we finally know.
It shares similar frequencies with Tacet Discords' Reverberations. It resembles an Echo processed by the Data Bank, stored inside your body instead of a Terminal.
In other words, it's your own Echo, captured or absorbed at some point. Without you, it can't manifest.
That's why Baizhi couldn't confirm just how you absorbed that Echo back then. Was it you? Was it the little one? Or maybe, the two of you together?

The bond between you and this creature is symbiotic. As it strengthens, so do you. However, if one is harmed, the other suffers.

The bond between you and this creature is symbiotic. As it strengthens, so do you. However, if one is harmed, the other suffers.
Fortunately, since it can't ever leave your side, it's not an easy target for attackers. And if they do strike, it can seek shelter inside your body for safety.

Wait, wait! This is too much information for me to process! Let me get this straight. So, it helped Rover fight off the Threnodian?
Seriously? This teeny tiny thing could do that? Hmm. Seems unlikely...

With both parties present, this hearing is now in session. Let us begin.
First, a brief overview of the case before us.
Ms. Zhezhi alleges that the guilty party, Mingyan, implicated in the Tacet Discord Assault, was coerced into committing art fraud under duress.
Therefore, her mental state was adversely affected, which led to her committing actions contrary to her will.

Today, based on new evidence provided by Ms. Zhezhi and the result of this hearing, we will determine whether to revisit Mingyan's charges and consider if the Shanyun Art Exchange is indeed guilty of selling illegal art forgeries.
What?! With all due respect, this doesn't match what we discussed before!
Mr. Baici, I remind you that any evidence or arguments presented before and during the hearing are valid.
If you would like to add further information, you are welcome to do so at any point.
Now, without further ado, either party may begin their opening statement.
Madam Juyao, th-the situation is...
Madam Juyao, as the head of the Shanyun Art Exchange, I, Baici, must clear our name and seek justice here today.

There are two points I'd like to address. Firstly, the authenticity of our artworks remains unimpeachable. Secondly, Mingyan's provocative creations stem solely from her own greed and vanity. She alone should bear responsibility for the assault.
Throughout my tenure at the Art Exchange, our foremost principle has been that of integrity, a well known fact. And yet...
Integrity in business is not enough to stave off discord.
We are aware of certain painters, rejected by the Art Exchange, nursing grudges, and resorting to threats...
They bombarded us with spite and slander, causing a public uproar simply because they didn't get what they wanted.
Should the public be swayed by these slanderous insinuations, that paint us as wicked fraudsters, then I'm afraid justice will never be served!
Please control yourself, Mr. Baici.
Forgive me, Madam, but if this injustice persists, I will have no choice but to sue them for harming the Shanyun Art Exchange's reputation. They have damaged the trust we built with our clients!

dialogs.content: The stone wall before you is called the Water Shadow Screen. It is naturally formed by years of continuous erosion from the waters of Sagaci Springs.
What's notable is that it inspired the ancestors of Hongzhen to invent a delightful form of entertainment—the Water Shadow Play.

All you need to do is gather some maple leaves that are scattered throughout the mountains and cut them into various shapes. Then, by using small twigs to manipulate them, the shadows of the leaves will dance in the water, bringing fascinating stories to life.
And that's why brewing and sipping tea while watching a Water Shadow Play became the favorite pastime for the folks of Mt. Firmament.

Thank you for coming, Rover.
Is that... the smell of Sonoro?!
Patty is now a portal to a Sonoro Sphere.
Its built-up frequencies likely resonated with something and created this.
Should we alert the Midnight Rangers? But then...
Then people might think there's another TD outbreak. Since a major fight has just happened, I think we should...
We'll handle it ourselves.
You're already planning to do so, I can tell. It's written all over your face.
Yes... I've thought it through. I believe that would be the most practical solution.
If the Sonoro is benign, we can all breathe a sigh of relief.
And worst-case scenario, if it turns malignant, you'll have no trouble handling it.
I just didn't expect you to bring it up first. Guess I wasted time hesitating.
You hesitated... because of the name "Pascar"?
Yes. He was a close friend of mine...
He died from the Waveworn. I think... if this Sonoro Sphere is related to him, it must contain his messages for me.
This is my personal request, {PlayerName}. Please help me.
Sure thing. In fact, I'm also doing this for a personal reason.
You are?

dialogs.content: Sorry I kept you waiting, {PlayerName}.
No worries. Is Patty alright?
I found some unusual frequencies inside its body. Not sure if that's the Sonoro Sphere's influence.
Out of safety concerns, I locked it up for the time being.
Normally I would. But not this time, because I promised you a gift.
Here, please take this.
I know you're going to the Moonlit Fair. Here's a camera to capture memories for you to keep.
It can be. Maybe I should include it in the employee handbook.
Not yet. That's why I'm about to write one.
I couldn't have solved this so fast without you by my side.
Those wishes were their cries for help. Someone had to act fast and save them, or there could have been severe consequences.
Thanks to your help, people can see their wishes come true.
The fulfilled wishes bring warmth and comfort to be shared by many more.
In the end, the Moontree Lodge kept its promise... to everyone, including Pascar.
What about you? What is your wish?
My wish? I haven't really thought about it in a while... But I may already know the answer to your question.
It's the same reason why I'm taking care of the Moontree Lodge: I want to follow in our pioneers' footsteps.
Those who forsake everything in pursuit of truth, and those who dedicate their lives to the welfare of others.
My parents each embodied one path. They were my role models, and I have strived to emulate them both.
Their passing left me searching for answers, for a way to find balance between the two.
That was why I inherited the Moontree Lodge. Still, I've often questioned: how closely should I follow my parents' paths?
Should I abandon all social connections in pursuit of the elusive ultimate truth, like in a certain story?
But in the end, you didn't do that.
No, I didn't. Because Pascar found me and brought me out of my room. Without him, I never would've known about my father's ties to the Moontree Lodge.
When Pascar left the Academy, I considered going with him.
Perhaps we are the same kind of people after all.
I wanted to give up everything for the ultimate truth, but I still craved companionship. That's why I hesitated.
Seeking truth can be futile. It's like constantly pushing a boulder uphill, only for the Lament to send it back down every time.
In this disaster-stricken world, our beliefs, innovations, even entire societies risk falling into oblivion in an instant.
Still, someone must push the boulder of curiosity and explore uncharted territories beyond that hill.
I've longed to push that boulder, Rover. Perhaps one day, I'll give in to the urge... Even if it means leaving everything behind.
Because it's there. Hard to resist the temptation when truth feels so close, almost within reach.
I've been trying to tell you for so, so long... I just want to let you know...
It's alright. You can venture as far as you need to. You will always return to open arms.
The way how you've always tried to clear Pascar's name, how he's done his utmost to tell you the truth. That's what we call a human connection.
That's why your memory worked as a "key" in the Sonoro Sphere.
Have more faith in humanity. The hero who pushed the boulder of truth for us all will be remembered, and the bond between people will endure.
Because we are here for you, always.
Hey, {PlayerName}! Over here!
Your friends are calling out to you.

content.content: Xiangli Yao? What are you doing here...
Still working on unfulfilled wishes from the Moontree Lodge?

I light and hang the fulfilled wishes. When the wisher cannot do it themselves, I do it for them.

Most of the fulfilled wishes had already been put up during the festival. There weren't many left from the beginning.

I can handle the rest on my own.

Well, you've been busy since your first day in Jinzhou. If you have some time to spare, that's more the reason to save that time for yourself.
Time files when we're having fun.
As the festivities wind down, the Moonlit Fair's stalls remain open. Perhaps you'd like to visit for one last round? You may even find some deals and specials at this time.
Having been to the fair every year, I always make time to explore the stalls that catch my interest.
Stay with us in Jinzhou for a couple more years, then I'm sure you'll become very familiar with the fair too.
Haha, indeed I find joy in scientific research. Immersing myself in data and theories, verifying various possibilities... It's a blissful experience.
But sometimes, taking a break from work to join the jubilant crowd brings a different kind of joy.

Xiangli Yao leads you to a certain place...

content.content: Is that the Moon Shooter game over there?

dialogs.content: Yes. I remember you seemed to enjoy it last time.
{PlayerName}, with your exceptional prowess in combat, I bet you're good at shooting too?
Then, may I suggest something more challenging?
Moon Shooter is very popular. While the stall owner changes the targets daily, the frequent use has caused some wear and tear.
That's why we need to lower the muzzle a bit. Make it easier to hit the bull's eye.

Now here's the exciting part: rotate the gun slightly and align it with the rabbit's ear, then you may hit two targets simultaneously. It's all about finding the right angle, and the bullet might rebound toward the next one.
Yes. You'll need to use the right angle and utilize the momentum. It's kind of like stone skipping.
I first tried it two years ago. On a good day, I could hit three targets at once.
They've been using my record as a promotional gimmick, offering an exclusive souvenir to anyone who can break it.
Good. I was a bit worried it wouldn’t interest you.
With {PlayerName} as the new challenger, I may not hold that record for long.

content.content: Have you ever tried one-shotting all the targets?

dialogs.content: Hmm... If I were to try that, I'd have to calculate the bullet trajectory to two decimal places.
Which technically isn't impossible with my prosthetic hand... but I'll probably get banned from ever playing again.
{PlayerName}, I'll stick to using my left hand to keep it a safe and fair competition.

After all, this isn't a scientific inquiry, and there's no end goal. We're here to enjoy ourselves, and I want to do that to the fullest. What do you think, {PlayerName}?

You heard me. The idea came to me as we gazed at the moon, side by side. While I'm not sure where you'll be, or what you'll be doing then... I want to invite you anyway.

I’m not planning to have you help me with the wishes at Moontree Lodge again. Maybe we'll try another game of Moon Shooting, or go sample some new treats at Yumyum Haven. Or we'll just follow the crowd, and see where it takes us...
Though it's still a long time before next year's celebration, I can't help but imagine what we might do together.
I don't have a specific plan yet, but with you, {PlayerName}... I have a feeling it's going to be fun.

Now I do have some ideas for next year.

dialogs.content: The Port City of Guixu... It once embodied the metropolitan dream.
Confidence and ambition fueled its growth, pushing the entire world forward.
People sailed every sea, explored every land. Everyone had food and shelter, living in peace.
Their spirits were high, optimism as tall as the skyscrapers. A bright future was surely inevitable, or so they thought.
See that brightly lit building? It was the tallest, reaching high enough to touch the heavens.
It was an era of high aspirations and big dreams. Life had infinite possibility.
Humanity's aspirations soared beyond the stars, searching for the edge of the universe itself.
Yes, because it was there, well within our reach...
Until...
I've never been to this city myself, not even in the Sonoro.
You were the one who told me about its rise and fall.
You've always been a witness.
I remember your smile when you described how prosperous it was.
But perhaps you had already foreseen its end and the issues that threaten us today.
The Lament will strike here in one hour.
My computations only recreated the city as it was in its final hour before disaster.
The more steps we take, the closer we draw to the inevitable destruction.
The moment the Lament starts is our chance to retrieve the data.
I'm sorry. We could never change history... or the "future" that already happened.
As one who has already walked this path, what did you experience? How did you... feel about it?
No.
I ask... because "I" want to know.
...Would you like to share it with me?

dialogs.content: Is there anything else you'd like to know about Ragunna? I'll do my best to answer your questions.
Our Sentinel embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. They are the lord of the sky and seas, protector of the land.
They freed us from division and conflict, treating all equally and uniting us as one.
Legends say the Sentinel's breath becomes a gentle breeze, blessing Ragunna's ships and guiding them safely to their destinations.
Their radiant gaze pierces the darkness, illuminating the way forward. In reverence, people built lighthouses across the island.
The Sentinel never boasts of Their deeds but bestows miracles in subtle ways, as it is written.
"I am the gentle breeze that caresses you in green meadows. I am the unseen guardian as you walk in the valley of shadows."
"I am with you, steadfast and unwavering, from the past, through the present, and beyond the future."
The Order of the Deep is Ragunna's de facto authority, handling everything from city management and disputes to diplomacy.
We revere our Sentinel and act on Their behalf, overseeing all Common Echoes.
The La Guardia, the armed Echoes you saw before you entered the city, are part of the Order, working alongside us to keep Ragunna safe and orderly.
By the Sentinel's will, all citizens of Ragunna can use Common Echoes by simply registering their information with the Nexus.
If you face any issues during your stay, please report them to the Order. We are here to ensure your stay is comfortable.
The Carnevale is Rinascita's grandest annual festival, lasting seven days. Its theme is said to be "transcend the flesh to the divine realm."

The outer seas of Rinascita were once plagued by Tacet Discords and Lament occurrences, making sea travel impossible. Isolated on the island, the Ragunnesi found solace in the epics recited by limping poets and ballads sung by blind singers.
Stories from many lands were shared, forming a cradle of culture and art. The people mingled, dreaming of the world beyond, envisioning a different life for themselves.

These dreams came to life during the spring rite in honor of the Sentinel. People dressed in costumes, setting aside their positions and prejudices to come together for a grand parade—this is the origin of today's Carnevale.
A stage will be set on the first day of the Carnevale. Wear a mask, and you can be part of the show.
The masks set people free, allowing everyone to shed their usual roles and revel in the celebration. We haven't had a Carnevale in many years, so this one is poised to be pretty special.
The streets will be alive with spectacular performances. Vendors from far and wide will showcase unique items.
Even without a mask, you can still take in the atmosphere and pick up some souvenirs.
In Rinascita, anyone can summon Common Echoes from the Nexus, whether they're a Resonator or not.
It has been modified by our Sentinel to allow Echoes to appear in physical forms.
However, not all Common Echoes are available for personal use. For example, La Guardia are armed guards managed exclusively by the Order.
Echoes affiliated with the Order are identified by their halo and respond only to its members, so please be aware of this.
If you have any further questions, please feel free to ask. It's our duty as Acolytes to assist every visitor.

I believe this is your first time using our service. As the Montelli family's esteemed guest, we're upgrading your account to Gold Membership.
Mercurio here will sort out your subscription. He's about as lively as a cash machine, so give him a moment.
Yes, all Echoes here belong to the Montelli family. Mercurio's designed to provide self-service banking.

The Montellis also put me in charge as your bodyguard and tour guide for Ragunna. If you want to see the city before the Carnevale, I can arrange a travel itinerary. Perhaps a Thundering Mephis type of outing may suit you, hm?

dialogs.content: I found this when searching for information about Abby.
It remained hidden until the core leak in the Tethys System was finally resolved.
(That message... I think I should trust it.)
Imperator is Rinascita's Sentinel.
It is also the solution Tethys proposes. As Rinascita's Sentinel, Imperator should have the knowledge to fix Abby's weakening frequency.
Rinascita, also called the Land of Echoes, is renowned for its Echo technologies. It's home to many like Abby who have physical forms.
(Rinascita? I may finally learn who Abby really is...)
It just so happens that the best time to visit Rinascita is now.
Please take this with you.
To our esteemed business partner,

As the celebrated Carnevale returns to Rinascita, the Montelli family, proud organizers of this grand festival, extend an invitation for you to grace Ragunna with your esteemed presence and partake in the celebrations.
In the spirit of goodwill, we have arranged a modest sum for your use during your stay in Rinascita. These funds are available at your convenience at the Averardo Bank.

The Montelli family holds in high regard each of its many friendships. Should you choose to place the Blake Bloom upon the Golden Scale, we shall consider you our most honored guest and a lifelong friend of the family.
The Montelli family eagerly awaits your arrival.
The Montellis are one of the leading families in Ragunna, a city-state within Rinascita. Their trade connections with the Black Shores prompted this invitation.
It is Rinascita's grandest festival. During this time, Ragunna's port relaxes its regulations to welcome visitors.
"A majestic tribute to our Sentinel!"
"Food, wine, light shows, and a masquerade ball, topped with extraordinary Echo performances!"
"All are welcome, no matter your wealth or rank! Celebrate with us and let the joy and merriment never end!"
Yes. It's also an excellent travel destination.
However... Rinascita is particularly special to the Black Shores.
The Threnodian's revival in Jinzhou has triggered similar reactions in other countries, with Rinascita as the one exception. We've detected no frequency fluctuations related to Threnodians there.
While many of our Bloom Bearers have visited Rinascita city-states before, our presence is often met with a hint of skepticism.
Given the circumstances, the best approach would be to visit as a guest of a prominent family.
Are you leaving now?
Please wait... I'll open a portal for you.
Ah...
Opening a portal will drain your computing power. I think it's better served for Black Shores operations.
...I see.
I'll have Aalto arrange your transportation to Rinascita then.

dialogs.content: Ah, new allies born from the perils of the high seas! What better way to begin an epic story?
Merely my duty, dear friend. The mists thicken once more, shrouding this ever-tumultuous path. A maiden voyage for you, I presume?
These waters teem with colossal, mystical Tacet Discords. That behemoth you saw is called "Cetus the Tidebreaker."
It is a gentle giant that usually keeps to deep waters and exhibits no aggressive behavior...
I saw something odd on its hide. Could that be the cause of its madness?
That big fella smells of sadness and anger all over...
Well, well, who's this little beach ball? A talking Echo! Clever little thing! Got a name?
What? First off, I'm not little! And beach ball? Really? Also, spill your name before you go askin' mine!
Oh my, where are my manners? I do apologize.
Brant's the name, captain of this fine vessel. As you can tell, we are a troupe, a merry band of fools chasing freedom across the seas!
Please forgive the lack of propriety. Now, travelers from afar, may I know your names?
Humph, hear that?
Whoa, hold up! My name's Abby! This is {PlayerName}!
Aw, c'mon, enough with the fancy talk!... My name's Abby, and this is {PlayerName}.
Hehe, {PlayerName} and Abby! Splendid! "All who step aboard, guests of honor be! With names exchanged, friendship's born at sea!"
Ahoy, crew! Let's give our new mates a proper welcome!
Welcome to the one and only Troupe of Fools!
*Cheerful sounds*
Are those… Echoes? Incredible! Never seen 'em like this before. Hmph, they're almost as special as me… like, 60, no, 70% as special! *Hiccup*
Er...
Ha ha ha, your little companion is quite amusing. I presume you must be headed to Rinascita for the Carnevale?

Indeed it is! The crown jewel of Rinascita's calendar. Ah, the endless masquerades, the sumptuous feasts, the wine flowing like rivers, and the music that never sleeps! For a few glorious nights, all your cares disappear!
And at the Carnevale's peak, our Sentinel Imperator will crown the festival's finest performer with the "Laurel."
Ha! Of course not. No mortal's ever laid eyes on the divine Sentinel up in the heaven of heavens. But the Laureate may hear the Sentinel's voice.
We've got a real Laureate in our troupe. Shame he didn't sail with us today. Oh, the tales he would tell! You'd love to hear about his glory days.
Chatting with the Sentinel if you get the Laurel? That's somethin'!
Absolutely! It's been a decade since the last Carnevale. We're not about to miss this one.
Sentinel or Laurel, it matters not...
The Troupe of Fools shall forever breathe freedom and unbridled joy into that city.
...Huh?
It's the fog.
Fog? Ew, I don't like the smell coming from the sea now.
Beware, my friends. The fog can affect Echoes.
This isn't just bad weather. It's a Waveworn Phenomenon. Many Tacet Discords lurk in the fog, ready to obliterate any passing ship.
But fear not! Our vessel shall not perish here! Before you stands a seasoned captain!
Hark, brave crew! Secure the lines and unfurl the sails! The helm is mine to command!
The final curtain shall not fall here! Our saga must endure!

You know, they always start as nobodies until they meet a divination master who sets them on the right path.
An opportunity, isn't it? That's why I decided to learn divination myself.
I thought I was getting pretty good, so I tried using divination to find my lost glasses.
First try said they were under the bed. The second try, on the rooftop. The third try, in my pocket.
Well, I couldn't find them anywhere, so I just bought a new pair.
That's when I realized divination isn't as magical as in those hero plays.
It's mostly for fun. No need to take it too seriously. But hey, it's not bad to believe in something… Maybe I just need a bit more practice.

dialogs.content: Seek salvation from where all began... What's that supposed to mean?
This inscription tells the tale of Rinascita's founding. Legends speak of a group of displaced people, driven from their lands by the Lament.
Though their origins were different, they followed the same ocean currents to a hidden sea.
They prayed for paradise but were met with a nightmare filled with Tacet Discords. The sky darkened, the sea roared, and towering waves threatened to engulf them.
At that moment, a radiant light pierced the clouds, and a voice resounded from the sky—
"Make the waters your second home, like seabirds nesting along the coast. Build your shelters hither and thither, like stars in the night sky."
"Your fortress is fragile, made only of wickers and planks, but fear not, for it is strong enough to withstand the wuthering waves."
Heeding the heavenly voice, the displaced united. A gentle breeze guided their ships, filling their sails with wind.
Through the storm, they glimpsed a bright light from an unnamed island. This was the light of the Genesis Nexus.

The Nexus granted them knowledge of Echoes and sent them to help build their cities. The people named the island Rinascita and built sanctuaries with inscriptions, honoring the voice that guided them to paradise.
The voice did indeed reveal itself. The faithful saw the true form of their savior, who declared its sacred name—Imperator.
This inscription tells the tale of Rinascita's founding. Legends speak of a group of displaced people, driven from their lands by the Lament.
Guided by the Nexus, they found refuge on this island where they learned the secrets of the Echoes and, under the Sentinel's watch, rebuilt their lives.
This legend is known widely among the Ragunnesi, though the true beginnings of Rinascita remain shrouded in lost history. Scholars of the Order have never stopped their quest to uncover it.
Got it. Now where can we meet the Sentinel?
You wish for an audience with the Sentinel...?
Yes, only one person has received such an honor—the current Primus, Fenrico.
...Yes. The Sentinel bestows the Laurel, through which the chosen one can hear Their voice. Only one has received such an honor—the current Primus, Fenrico.
As the only Enlightened One in recorded history, Primus Fenrico can directly connect with the Sentinel to heed divine oracles.

...Indeed. Primus Fenrico is the Sentinel Imperator's Resonator. As such he bears the title the Enlightened One. You'll have the chance to see him at the Carnevale when he announces the opening of the ceremony.
I hope you enjoy your time here in Ragunna and join in with the festivities.
If you need help with anything, just let me know. As an Acolyte, it's my job to assist all our visitors.

Now that I think about it, the frequency vibration I sensed felt a lot like... empathy.
Empathy…?
Well, maybe telepathy? Not sure. It's hard to explain…
Telepathy… Yes, according to legend, the Sentinel speaks directly into the mind of the Laureate. Could that be what happened?

So the "Imperator" is the Sentinel. But who's the "Lost"? Plus, it said it needs your help, but… a Sentinel shouldn't need to ask for help, wouldn't ya say? Eh, something's not adding up, what a headache...
(The Sentinel has countless ways to send a message, and through the Order is apparently the most convenient one, but why did they go through all the trouble...?)
(Maybe I'm wrong. Maybe calling for help was the only option?)
(With that message left on Tethys… Could the Sentinel here be in a situation similar to Jué's?)
(But it seems like the locals haven't laid eyes on their Sentinel. Everything feels off. That Echo might be our only lead right now.)
Yes, it was. The Montelli family has been promoting the use of Reserved Terminals and Echoes.
As far as I know, the Montelli family has been promoting the use of Reserved Terminals and Echoes.
Most Ragunnesi use Common Echoes and don't know much about the Reserved ones. The Montellis spotted a chance and started researching Reserved Terminals.
They push to bring back the Carnevale so they can showcase their Reserved Terminals, prove the quality of their Echoes, and attract both customers and investors.
Oh sorry, just a minute.
Yes, Mr. Alberto. An Echo was...
Zani recounts what happened to the caller. Moments later...
...I see.
Sorry to keep you waiting. That was Mr. Alberto from the Montelli family. Also my employer.
He extends a sincere apology for what just happened. They too are at a loss to explain what caused the accident.
He told me that the Montelli family would investigate further. Please rest assured.
No... After all, such an incident only hinders their promotion of Reserved Terminals. They have no reason to rejoice over it.
Come to think of it, that Echo... it was looking at you. It seemed to target you.

My orders are to guard and to guide. I do my job. Nothing more, nothing less. So if you want to investigate, I'll stick with you until you're done.
Don't thank me, thank the family who hired me. Their generosity is beyond what you can imagine.
Thank you for trusting in my abilities.

It was complete chaos, but I spied the direction it fled… We can try our luck at the Pioneer Association.

dialogs.content: Dear Sentinel above…
Oh, the Sentinel is in a great rage! They are warning us, reminding us of our follies.
We shouldn't have forgotten... Ten years ago, it was our unbridled indulgence that brought about divine punishment!
We should have heeded Primus Fenrico's words…

Oh, dear visitor from afar, you may not know. Ten years ago, the Carnevale angered the Sentinel and brought forth divine punishment. Primus Fenrico foresaw the shadow beneath the revelry and halted its spread!
Simply put, many terrible accidents happened during that Carnevale, like Echoes losing control. Since then, the Primus ordered the Carnevale to stop.
Most Ragunnesi don't like to talk about that tragedy, so it's understandable you haven't heard of it.
Echoes are messengers of the Sentinel. They lost control and attacked people because they were corrupted, reflecting our transgressions against the Sentinel!
This year, the Order has approved the Carnevale. We will return to our traditions… Dear visitor, please join us in praising the Sentinel. Only then can our misguided souls be forgiven…

It may be a divine blessing, but it has committed an assault against the Sentinel's people. The corrupted will be purified under the holy light of the Genesis Nexus. As for the one that escaped, the Order will retrieve it as soon as possible to prevent further harm.
In other words, the Echo will be reset in the Data Bank. That's how we Ragunnesi usually deal with malfunctioning Echoes.
We deeply apologize for the disturbance caused by that undisciplined Echo… Now, please excuse me. I have other matters to attend to.
The Acolyte leaves while murmuring to herself.

She may not have given us anything useful, but she did remind me of one thing—that Vitreum Dancer's behavior was different from those Echoes that went wild in the past. It seemed to have a clear goal and a sentience.
The Echoes are connected with each other, so usually if one loses control, the others will be affected too. However, we haven't received any reports of other Echoes losing control.
If it wasn't the Sentinel's punishment, it could have been…
You're right. We need to catch it before the Order does, or we won't be able to get the information we need.

dialogs.content: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Welcome to the Pioneer Association!
Ms. Zani! It's been some time! Have you finally decided to join us?
No, I'm here for something else. This is Mr. Fulmine from the Pioneer Association.
Oh, hello! You've brought a new friend! Pleasure to meet you. I'm Fulmine, head of the Wutherium Film Studio under the Pioneer Association in Ragunna. How should I address you?
Your name rings a bell… Oh! Y-you're the legendary Rover?!
Savior from a foreign land, the dark thunderbolt streaking across the world… I've longed to meet you! By the Sentinel, let me seize this extraordinary moment!
Wait, you're actually some kind of celebrity?

Ha, indeed {Male=he;Female=she} is. Ragunna's routes have only recently opened, so {Male=his;Female=her} feats haven't made it here yet. Should you perform a great deed, trust me to ensure your name echoes throughout Ragunna!
I had a nagging feeling I've met someone important... But let's get back to what matters.
We're here to ask a favor. We're investigating a Vitreum Dancer who caused a scene around Trattoria Margherita.
We're here to ask a favor. We're investigating a Vitreum Dancer who caused a scene around Trattoria Margherita.
It fled in this direction, and we're wondering if you can recreate the scene for us.
Ah, I know the one you mean. Saw it streaking out of the city with a few Order fellows in tow.
As for recreating the scene… C-MOSS, my friend, it's time to get to work!
Hmph.
Alright, where is it? My memory of that Vitreum Dancer… Ah, I've found it!
Mr. Fulmine's Forte is Celluloid Chronicle. He can convert events into film, recording all that happens within a span of time.
His partner, C-MOSS, uses a "Memory Projector" Forte to show these captured moments.
There it is! Take a look!
So it did leave the city… This complicates matters. The area beyond is too vast to search effectively. Plus, Tacet Discords are hampering our investigation. We can't start searching just yet.
(…What do you think I am? Not a chance! And I'm too sleepy to help, just wake me if there's any progress…)
I'm sorry. I can only record what is plain to the eye.
Don't be hard on yourself, Mr. Fulmine. You've been a tremendous help. At least we're not flying blind anymore. But {PlayerName}, we need a new plan.
…Give me a moment. Ah, yes! Look at this!
How could this be...
His garb suggests he's from the Montelli family. Could they be involved in this turmoil?
Indeed. But it's rare to wear a mask before the Carnevale. He must have wanted to hide his face.
Speaking of, the mask is not the typical Montelli style, and wearing it now is unusual.
With their eagerness to promote Reserved Terminals, the Montellis would be the last to invite trouble now. If he's tied to the disturbance...
Then perhaps we should seek Ms. Nyarla's expertise. She's known for her intricate masks, and this one seems custom.
Good idea, but nobles are secretive. Direct questions might lead to unwanted attention.
Ah-ha, Excellent. Let's make for the Masked Reverie.

dialogs.content: Ha, Antonio, surely you know how things work here. It's always about who pays more. Is there a problem?
Do you Fisalias even honor contracts?
Ha, since when do Montellis fret over such trivialities?
Instead of whining, maybe focus on cleaning up the mess your Echoes caused. Ha ha ha...
The Fisalia man walks away, leaving Antonio fuming.
And you are…?
Greetings, Sir Antonio. I'm Zani from the Averardo Bank.
This {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} here is a distinguished guest of your family, {PlayerName}. {Male=He;Female=She} was attacked by a rogue Vitreum Dancer while dining, and we're investigating.
Ah, so you're… Please accept my apologies! It's a relief to see you unscathed. We're as puzzled as you are about the Echo's behavior.
Miss Carlotta asked me to hold nothing back, so ask away.
Well, before I do, a little context first.
In Ragunna, the Order controls all Terminals for Echo use. They store Echoes in their Data Bank and only grant access after thorough screening.
Only a select few Resonators are permitted to carry a Reserved Terminal.
You see, most Ragunnesi rely on the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, with little need for the special access types.
However, things have changed with Ragunna opening up to the greater Solaris. People want to travel, making Reserved Terminals essential for safety outside the Order's reach.
You see why demand is up. The Montellis saw an opportunity and started to develop them. After all, necessity is the mother of invention, hm?
It should be celebrated, but some think we disrespect the Order's authority or even the Sentinel by doing this. The path forward has been... resistant.
Heh, if you ask me, I suspect the Fisalia family has been spreading slanders about us.
We back the Carnevale to showcase our Reserved Terminals to the people. It's our chance to prove their worth and attract investors.
Sigh… The Fisalias have coerced our miners to break their contracts, seizing our largest vein and cutting off our Terminal supply.
They say the Fisalias have been seen frequenting the Cathedral of Mercury. They must be in league with the Order. How else would they dare to seize our mine so boldly?
And it gets worse. With the Carnevale nearing and our Echoes malfunctioning, the family's Executor might have to step in.
The Carnevale is at risk. While we hope it brings fortune, the festival itself is what truly matters to us, just like the rest of Ragunna.
We must uncover why the Echo lost control. We cannot let the Fisalias use this to tarnish our reputation any further!
That would be good for us, but it hardly seems proper to involve our esteemed guest in our troubles...

Ah, understood. Thank you! But I'm afraid we can't spare any of our own to assist you. Rest assured, the Montellis are always generous. Here's an advance. Once the matter is resolved, you'll be well-rewarded.
Take it. In Ragunna, if you want help, you must offer a reward and one only declines a reward when they refuse to help.
Yes, that's right. Please accept it. If that's all, I must be on my way. There are many matters to attend to...
Antonio departs with a sigh. The weight on his shoulders seems heavier than before.
From what we know, the Montelli family has no motive for such incidents. They've been anticipating the Carnevale's arrival.

But the Fisalia family is another story. They've been against the celebration from the start, perhaps they could be behind everything? But I don't understand, what could they hope to gain by stopping the Carnevale?
Why do I feel like I've gotten myself into something above my pay grade…
You... have a hunch, hm?
You're right. Let's go.

dialogs.content: Ah, more seekers. What brings you to these halls?
Sir Gilberto...? Oh, Gilberto from the Fisalia family.
A pious soul, frequently here in prayer. But not today, it seems.
I've heard whispers of you. An Acolyte mentioned your desire to meet the Sentinel. I assume you must be interested in following Their path.
But I don't think you truly understand the significance of the Carnevale. Allow me to explain.
You've probably heard about the connection between the Carnevale and the Sentinel, but do you know why the Carnevale hasn't been held for years?
In the last Carnevale, a sea fog shrouded the entire city. Echoes paraded like lost souls, a dragon roared above, and a beast in the sea stirred up towering waves…
It was sent as punishment and warning against our indulgence and division.
This is our Primus, Fenrico, the Enlightened One.
Amidst that chaos, he stepped forward and quelled the Sentinel's wrath.
Ragunna's greatness was forged from its battles with the sea. It inspired a common goal in all our hearts.
Without everyone working together, land cannot be cultivated, islands cannot unite, and dams cannot be built. A nation's strength lies in its unity.
You see, this is why we preach restraint and control over our desires. Only through rituals can we strengthen our resolve, our unity!
This is why we must banish those who stray from the right path and impose restrictions on those who threaten the common good.
We've dedicated ourselves to this cause.
Hehe, you misunderstand me.
I simply mean that the Order's actions are always made with great deliberation.
Guided by the Sentinel, we strive to unite and lead the people. We hope to build a kingdom on high, a land of the blessed… As it was in the beginning, and ever shall be.
I trust you'll have faith in the Order's judgment. We handle all matters that come to our attention.
...What did you say? How could the Montelli family...
Forgive me, I must attend to pressing matters.
If you have further questions, seek answers in the cathedral. We are always open to those in search of truth.
But I remind you to keep your distance from the sacred relics and honor our customs. Otherwise, we will have no choice but to address any act of disrespect.

dialogs.content: Here we are. The true splendors of Montelli's heritage.
Are these all Echoes in the cases?
Yes, and no. They are Echoes but also the promise of Rinascita's future—and, above all, freedom.
Rinascita may be a fledgling country, but it boasts centuries of history. Its foray into the wider world, however, only began a few years ago.
Don't you find it peculiar? Rinascita, the Land of Echoes… leads the world in Echo technology, yet stands so insular and unadventurous.
What do you suppose is behind all this?
The "Echoes" themselves.
Sharp as always. Rinascita's Common Echoes are bound to Genesis Nexus, making seafaring with them almost impossible.
But their power is essential for dealing with Tacet Discords and other threats at sea. You could say the reliance on Common Echoes has shackled our ambitions to venture beyond our borders.
To break these shackles, the Montelli family has invested in Reserved Terminals. It's not about short-term benefits, but the future for the whole of Ragunna.

The Order has monopolized the use of Common Echoes and kept a tight leash on Reserved Terminals, claiming that individual ownership would sully the sanctity of the Echoes they so fervently preach about.
But you see their real objective, don't you? To keep Rinascita isolated so they can shape its entire narrative.
And the Fisalia family has covertly aligned with the Order, aiming to crush our efforts and therefore the prospect of Reserved Terminals. They've even gone so far as to seek Fractsidus' aid.
Such is the reality of the Land of Echoes—whoever controls the Echoes controls Rinascita.
My forebears began collecting these Echoes long before the Vault existed, when the Montelli family was nothing more than a third-rate house ridiculed for its adventurous spirit.

They ventured out to sea for trades and got their hands on Terminals of the most basic model. From there, they've been tirelessly collecting Echoes and advancing the technology. Brick by brick, they built this enterprise that you see today.
You are probably wondering, how does this relates to the Vitreum Dancer? Well, the one that came to you at the Carnevale rehearsal is among our family's earliest Echoes.
As both the first Vitreum Dancer and the prototype for the frequency tuning of all subsequent models, its value is truly unparalleled.
It was never meant to be deployed and should have been preserved here in a case forever. But somehow, it found its way to the Carnevale… just to meet you.
So, you're saying…
This is no coincidence. I can only assume it was the design of Sentinel Imperator.
Here are some files about the Vitreum Dancer. Perhaps they can offer you some insights.

dialogs.content: There was a time when the currents swept us into the jaws of uncharted waters, where relentless storms and voracious waves awaited. But after weathering such trials, they revealed to us a hidden gem—the Shores themselves.

My family has always been drawn to the thrill of a new voyage. One stormy night, fate decided to play a hand. What we discovered there on that island, the technology and novel ideas, was nothing short of a blessing in disguise.
There exists only one relatively safe route from the Black Shores to Ragunna—a path known solely to the Montelli family. As long as you stayed on this course, you were bound to encounter the troupe.
Exactly. When we heard the Black Shores were hunting for a legitimate entry into Ragunna, I thought, why not bring them into our little venture? Hence, the invitation.
Our intentions might not be as grandiose or ominous as you think. We seek liberation, and to achieve it, we're pursuing the truth behind Rinascita's origins.
Legend has it that when people first arrived on this island, <ano=The first beacon in Rinascita>Genesis Nexus</ano> was already here, welcoming them.

The prevailing belief is that the Sentinel gifted us this technology, and despite nobody ever seeing the Sentinel in person, we talk with Them through supposed "telepathy." Notice anything strange about that story?
Terminals conjure up Echoes, and the Genesis Nexus allows the Ragunnesi access to Common Echoes.
If the Genesis Nexus was present when the first settlers arrived, who built it?
And really, if no one's ever laid eyes on the Sentinel, how can we be so sure that statue really represents Them?
It seems to me the Order might have spun us a tale, hiding the true origins behind their grand myths.
No, we have no ambitions to rule or to renounce our faith. And really, this city should not be ruled by any one entity.
The hour grows late. I have arranged accommodations for you at Palazzo Agrotta in the south. Let us walk there together, and I can share a story along the way.
Think of it as a bedtime tale. I learned it from the troupe. It is about Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden.

In Ragunna, those who break the law are sent to the Order Tribunal for sentencing. Those who violate the sacred doctrines are branded as Fools and sent away on the Pilgrim's Sail.

It's said that when the first Dark Tide ravaged Rinascita, the first Primus followed the currents on a rickety boat and met the Sentinel in person. That's where the Pilgrim's Sail tradition came from.
Now, the Fools retrace the Primus's journey, reflecting on their mistakes along the way.
There's a strong undercurrent around this isle, likely caused by that first Dark Tide. It drags all Pilgrim's Sails here unless the ship's course is altered.

The people must have escaped, but with the mist this thick, we need to stay on guard.
Pero, pero!
This way. Head to the lighthouse.

Watch your back.
